conclusion: JUBAKU-v2是一个有价值的新基准，用于评估LLM推理中特定文化背景下的社会偏见，提供比现有方法更灵敏的检测能力。

title: Toward Efficient Deployment and Synchronization in Digital Twins-Empowered Networks
authors: Hossam Farag, Cedomir Stefanovic
abstract: Digital twins (DTs) are envisioned as a key enabler of the cyber-physical continuum in future wireless networks. However, efficient deployment and synchronization of DTs in dynamic multi-access edge computing (MEC) environments remains challenging due to time-varying communication and computational resources. This paper investigates the joint optimization of DT deployment and synchronization in dynamic MEC environments. A deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework is proposed for adaptive DT placement and association to minimize interaction latency between physical and digital entities. To ensure semantic freshness, an update scheduling policy is further designed to minimize the long-term weighted sum of the Age of Changed Information (AoCI) and the update cost. A relative policy iteration algorithm with a threshold-based structure is developed to derive the optimal policy. Simulation results show that the proposed methods achieve lower latency, enhanced information freshness, and reduced system cost compared with benchmark schemes
zh_title: 数字孪生赋能网络中高效部署与同步研究
translation: 数字孪生（DTs）被认为是未来无线网络中实现赛博物理连续体的关键使能技术。然而，在动态多接入边缘计算（MEC）环境中，由于时变的通信和计算资源，数字孪生的高效部署和同步仍然充满挑战。本文研究了动态MEC环境中数字孪生部署和同步的联合优化问题。提出了一种深度强化学习（DRL）框架，用于自适应的数字孪生放置和关联，以最小化物理和数字实体之间的交互延迟。为了确保语义新鲜度，进一步设计了一种更新调度策略，以最小化信息变化年龄（AoCI）和更新成本的长期加权和。开发了一种基于阈值结构的相对策略迭代算法来推导最优策略。仿真结果表明，所提出的方法与基准方案相比，实现了更低的延迟、增强的信息新鲜度和降低的系统成本。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种深度强化学习框架，用于在动态多接入边缘计算环境中优化数字孪生的部署和同步，以最小化交互延迟、提升信息新鲜度和降低系统成本。
ai_comments: 本论文的创新点在于提出了一个结合深度强化学习的联合优化框架，同时解决了数字孪生的部署和同步问题。特别地，引入信息变化年龄（AoCI）作为衡量信息新鲜度的指标，并将其与更新成本结合进行优化，体现了对语义新鲜度的关注。这种方法对于提升未来数字孪生赋能网络的性能和效率具有重要意义。
motivation: 数字孪生在未来无线网络中是关键技术，但在动态多接入边缘计算（MEC）环境中，由于时变的通信和计算资源，数字孪生的高效部署和同步仍面临挑战。
method: 提出了一种深度强化学习（DRL）框架，用于自适应的数字孪生放置和关联，以最小化物理和数字实体之间的交互延迟。为确保语义新鲜度，设计了一种更新调度策略，以最小化信息变化年龄（AoCI）和更新成本的长期加权和。开发了一种基于阈值结构的相对策略迭代算法来推导最优策略。
results: 仿真结果表明，与基准方案相比，所提出的方法实现了更低的延迟、增强的信息新鲜度和降低的系统成本。
conclusion: 所提出的深度强化学习框架和更新调度策略能够有效解决动态多接入边缘计算环境中数字孪生部署和同步的挑战，显著提升系统性能。

title: Dual-Select FMA Butterfly for FFT: Eliminating Twiddle Factor Singularities with Bounded Precomputed Ratios
authors: Mohamed Amine Bergach
abstract: The fused multiply-add (FMA) instruction enables the radix-2 FFT butterfly to be computed in 6~FMA operations -- the proven minimum. The classical factorization by Linzer and Feig~\cite{linzer1993} precomputes the ratio $\cotθ= \cosθ/\sinθ$, which is singular when the twiddle factor is $W^0 = 1$ (i.e., $\sinθ= 0$). Standard practice clamps $\sinθ$ to a small epsilon, degrading numerical precision. We observe that an alternative factorization using $\cosθ$ as the outer multiplier (precomputing $\tanθ$) avoids this particular singularity but introduces a new one at $W^{N/4}$. We then propose a \emph{dual-select} strategy that chooses, per twiddle factor, whichever factorization yields $|\text{ratio}| \leq 1$. This eliminates all singularities, requires no epsilon clamping, and bounds the precomputed ratio to unity for all twiddle factors. For $N = 1024$, the worst-case ratio drops from 163 (Linzer-Feig) to exactly~1.0 (dual-select), yielding a $235\times$ tighter error bound in FP16 arithmetic over 10~FFT passes. The strategy adds zero computational overhead -- only the precomputed twiddle table changes.
zh_title: 用于FFT的双选择FMA蝶形：通过有界预计算比率消除旋转因子奇异性
translation: 融合乘加（FMA）指令使得基-2 FFT蝶形运算可以在6次FMA操作中完成——这是已证实的最小值。Linzer和Feig~	extcite{linzer1993}的经典分解预计算了比率cotθ = cosθ/sinθ，当旋转因子W^0 = 1（即sinθ = 0）时，该比率是奇异的。标准做法是将sinθ钳位到一个小的epsilon值，从而降低了数值精度。我们观察到，使用cosθ作为外部乘数（预计算tanθ）的替代分解避免了这种特定的奇异性，但在W^(N/4)处引入了新的奇异性。然后，我们提出了一种双选择策略，即针对每个旋转因子，选择能使|比率| ≤ 1的分解方式。这消除了所有奇异性，无需epsilon钳位，并将预计算比率限制在所有旋转因子都为1。对于N = 1024，最差比率从163（Linzer-Feig）精确降至1.0（双选择），在10次FFT传递的FP16算术中，误差界限收紧了235倍。该策略没有增加任何计算开销——只有预计算的旋转因子表发生了变化。
tldr: 本文提出了一种“双选择”策略，用于FFT的FMA蝶形计算，通过针对每个旋转因子选择合适的分解方式（cotθ或tanθ），消除了所有旋转因子奇异性，无需epsilon钳位，并将预计算比率限制在1，显著提高了数值精度且无额外计算开销。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提出了一种简洁而有效的解决方案，解决了FFT中FMA蝶形计算长期存在的数值稳定性问题。其创新点在于通过“双选择”策略，巧妙地规避了旋转因子的奇异点，避免了传统的epsilon钳位带来的精度损失。在不增加计算复杂度的前提下，显著提高了FP16等低精度算术下的精度和鲁棒性，对于高性能计算和嵌入式系统中的FFT实现具有重要意义。
motivation: 经典的FMA FFT蝶形算法（Linzer和Feig）在预计算比率cotθ时，当旋转因子W^0=1（即sinθ=0）时会出现奇异性。标准做法通过将sinθ钳位到一个小的epsilon值来处理，但这会降低数值精度。本文旨在解决这一数值精度下降的问题并消除所有奇异性。
method: 本文观察到，使用cotθ的经典分解在W^0处存在奇异性，而使用tanθ的替代分解则在W^(N/4)处引入新的奇异性。为此，本文提出了一种“双选择”策略：针对每个旋转因子，选择能使预计算比率|ratio| ≤ 1的分解方式（即cotθ或tanθ）。
results: 该策略成功消除了所有奇异性，无需进行epsilon钳位，并将所有旋转因子的预计算比率限制在1。对于N=1024的情况，最差比率从Linzer-Feig方法的163降至双选择方法的1.0。这在FP16算术下，经过10次FFT传递后，误差界限收紧了235倍。该策略没有增加任何计算开销，仅改变了预计算的旋转因子表。
conclusion: 通过引入“双选择”策略，本文成功地解决了FFT中FMA蝶形计算的旋转因子奇异性问题，显著提高了数值精度和稳定性，同时保持了计算效率。

title: Representation choice shapes the interpretation of protein conformational dynamics
authors: Axel Giottonini, Thomas Lemmin
abstract:
Molecular dynamics simulations provide detailed trajectories at the atomic level, but extracting interpretable and robust insights from these high-dimensional data remains challenging. In practice, analyses typically rely on a single representation. Here, we show that representation choice is not neutral: it fundamentally shapes the conformational organization, similarity relationships, and apparent transitions inferred from identical simulation data.
  To complement existing representations, we introduce Orientation features, a geometrically grounded, rotation-aware encoding of protein backbone. We compare it against common descriptions across three dynamical regimes: fast-folding proteins, large-scale domain motions, and protein-protein association. Across these systems, we find that different representations emphasize complementary aspects of conformational space, and that no single representation provides a complete picture of the underlying dynamics.
  To facilitate systematic comparison, we developed ManiProt, a library for efficient computation and analysis of multiple protein representations. Our results motivate a comparative, representation-aware framework for the interpretation of molecular dynamics simulations.
zh_title: 表征选择塑造了对蛋白质构象动力学的解读
translation: 分子动力学模拟提供了原子水平的详细轨迹，但从这些高维数据中提取可解释且稳健的见解仍然具有挑战性。在实践中，分析通常依赖于单一的表征。在这里，我们证明了表征的选择并非中立：它从根本上塑造了从相同模拟数据中推断出的构象组织、相似性关系和表观转换。为了补充现有的表征，我们引入了Orientation features，这是一种基于几何、具有旋转感知能力的蛋白质骨架编码。我们在三个动力学体系中将其与常见描述进行了比较：快速折叠蛋白质、大规模结构域运动和蛋白质-蛋白质结合。在这些系统中，我们发现不同的表征强调了构象空间中互补的方面，并且没有单一的表征能够提供潜在动力学的完整图景。为了促进系统性比较，我们开发了ManiProt，一个用于高效计算和分析多种蛋白质表征的库。我们的结果推动了一种用于解释分子动力学模拟的、对比式的、具备表征意识的框架。
tldr: 分子动力学分析中选择哪种特征表征至关重要，作者通过开发ManiProt工具库证明了不同表征具有互补性，并建议采用多表征对比框架以获得更全面的动力学洞察。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了分子动力学分析中一个常被忽视的关键问题：表征方式的选择会直接影响对蛋白质动力学的解读。其创新之处在于提出了Orientation features这一几何表征，并开发了ManiProt工具库，推动了该领域向多视角、对比分析的范式转变，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 目前的分子动力学分析往往过度依赖单一的表征方式，而研究者尚未充分意识到表征选择对数据解读的偏向性影响，导致对高维数据提取的洞察可能存在偏差。
method: 引入了Orientation features（一种基于几何的旋转感知蛋白质骨架编码），并开发了ManiProt库用于高效计算和分析多种蛋白质表征，通过对比三种不同动力学系统下的表征效果进行评估。
results: 研究证实表征选择并非中立，会显著改变对构象组织、相似性关系及动力学转换的推断；Orientation features在捕捉蛋白质动力学特征方面具有独特优势，且各种表征之间存在互补性。
conclusion: 没有单一的表征能完整反映蛋白质的动力学全貌，研究者应采用对比式的、对表征敏感的分析框架来解读分子动力学数据。

title: UniMixer: A Unified Architecture for Scaling Laws in Recommendation Systems
authors: Mingming Ha, Guanchen Wang, Linxun Chen, Xuan Rao, Yuexin Shi, Tianbao Ma, Zhaojie Liu, Yunqian Fan, Zilong Lu, Yanan Niu, Han Li, Kun Gai
abstract: In recent years, the scaling laws of recommendation models have attracted increasing attention, which govern the relationship between performance and parameters/FLOPs of recommenders. Currently, there are three mainstream architectures for achieving scaling in recommendation models, namely attention-based, TokenMixer-based, and factorization-machine-based methods, which exhibit fundamental differences in both design philosophy and architectural structure. In this paper, we propose a unified scaling architecture for recommendation systems, namely \textbf{UniMixer}, to improve scaling efficiency and establish a unified theoretical framework that unifies the mainstream scaling blocks. By transforming the rule-based TokenMixer to an equivalent parameterized structure, we construct a generalized parameterized feature mixing module that allows the token mixing patterns to be optimized and learned during model training. Meanwhile, the generalized parameterized token mixing removes the constraint in TokenMixer that requires the number of heads to be equal to the number of tokens. Furthermore, we establish a unified scaling module design framework for recommender systems, which bridges the connections among attention-based, TokenMixer-based, and factorization-machine-based methods. To further boost scaling ROI, a lightweight UniMixing module is designed, \textbf{UniMixing-Lite}, which further compresses the model parameters and computational cost while significantly improve the model performance. The scaling curves are shown in the following figure. Extensive offline and online experiments are conducted to verify the superior scaling abilities of \textbf{UniMixer}.
zh_title: UniMixer：推荐系统中扩展定律的统一架构
translation: 近年来，推荐模型的扩展定律引起了越来越多的关注，这些定律控制着推荐器性能与参数/FLOPs之间的关系。目前，实现推荐模型扩展有三种主流架构，即基于注意力、基于TokenMixer和基于因子分解机的方法，它们在设计理念和架构结构上都表现出根本性的差异。在本文中，我们提出了一种推荐系统的统一扩展架构，即\textbf{UniMixer}，以提高扩展效率并建立一个统一的理论框架，统一主流的扩展模块。通过将基于规则的TokenMixer转换为等效的参数化结构，我们构建了一个广义的参数化特征混合模块，允许在模型训练期间优化和学习token混合模式。同时，广义参数化token混合消除了TokenMixer中要求头数等于token数的约束。此外，我们建立了一个推荐系统的统一扩展模块设计框架，它弥合了基于注意力、基于TokenMixer和基于因子分解机方法之间的联系。为了进一步提升扩展ROI，我们设计了一个轻量级的UniMixing模块，\textbf{UniMixing-Lite}，它在显著提高模型性能的同时，进一步压缩了模型参数和计算成本。扩展曲线如下图所示。进行了大量的离线和在线实验，以验证\textbf{UniMixer}卓越的扩展能力。
tldr: UniMixer提出了一种统一的推荐系统扩展架构，通过参数化TokenMixer并连接现有主流方法，旨在提高扩展效率和性能。
ai_comments: UniMixer的创新之处在于其统一了现有三种主流推荐系统扩展架构，并通过参数化TokenMixer使其混合模式可学习，这为推荐模型的设计提供了一个更灵活和高效的框架。其理论统一性和实践中的性能提升对推荐系统领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 近年来，推荐模型的扩展定律受到关注，现有三种主流架构（基于注意力、基于TokenMixer、基于因子分解机）在设计理念和结构上存在根本差异。
method: 提出UniMixer，通过将基于规则的TokenMixer转换为等效的参数化结构，构建广义参数化特征混合模块，使token混合模式可优化学习，并移除TokenMixer的约束。UniMixer建立了一个统一的扩展模块设计框架，连接了基于注意力、基于TokenMixer和基于因子分解机的方法。还设计了轻量级的UniMixing-Lite模块以进一步提升扩展ROI。
results: 大量的离线和在线实验验证了UniMixer卓越的扩展能力，并显示了扩展曲线。
conclusion: UniMixer提供了一个统一的推荐系统扩展架构，有效提升了扩展效率和模型性能，并统一了主流的扩展模块。

title: On the average-case complexity landscape for Tensor-Isomorphism-complete problems over finite fields
authors: Tiange Li, Yinan Li, Youming Qiao, Dacheng Tao, Yingjie Wang
abstract:
In Grochow and Qiao (SIAM J. Comput., 2021), the complexity class Tensor Isomorphism (TI) was introduced and isomorphism problems for groups, algebras, and polynomials were shown to be TI-complete. In this paper, we study average-case algorithms for several TI-complete problems over finite fields, including algebra isomorphism, matrix code conjugacy, and $4$-tensor isomorphism.
  Our main results are as follows. Over the finite field of order $q$, we devise (1) average-case polynomial-time algorithms for algebra isomorphism and matrix code conjugacy that succeed in a $1/Θ(q)$ fraction of inputs and (2) an average-case polynomial-time algorithm for the $4$-tensor isomorphism that succeeds in a $1/q^{Θ(1)}$ fraction of inputs. Prior to our work, algorithms for algebra isomorphism with rigorous average-case analyses ran in exponential time, albeit succeeding on a larger fraction of inputs (Li--Qiao, FOCS'17; Brooksbank--Li--Qiao--Wilson, ESA'20; Grochow--Qiao--Tang, STACS'21).
  These results reveal a finer landscape of the average-case complexities of TI-complete problems, providing guidance for cryptographic systems based on isomorphism problems. Our main technical contribution is to introduce the spectral properties of random matrices into algorithms for TI-complete problems. This leads to not only new algorithms but also new questions in random matrix theory over finite fields. To settle these questions, we need to extend both the generating function approach as in Neumann and Praeger (J. London Math. Soc., 1998) and the characteristic sum method of Gorodetsky and Rodgers (Trans. Amer. Math. Soc., 2021).
zh_title: 关于有限域上张量同构完全问题的平均情况复杂性景观的研究
translation: 在Grochow和Qiao（SIAM J. Comput., 2021）的工作中，引入了张量同构（TI）复杂性类，并证明了群、代数和多项式的同构问题是TI完全的。在本文中，我们研究了有限域上几个TI完全问题的平均情况算法，包括代数同构、矩阵码共轭和4-张量同构。我们的主要结果如下：在阶为q的有限域上，我们设计了（1）代数同构和矩阵码共轭的平均情况多项式时间算法，它们在1/Θ(q)的输入比例上成功；（2）4-张量同构的平均情况多项式时间算法，在1/q^{Θ(1)}的输入比例上成功。在此之前，具有严格平均情况分析的代数同构算法运行时间为指数级，尽管它们在更大的输入比例上成功。这些结果揭示了TI完全问题平均情况复杂性的更精细景观，为基于同构问题的密码系统提供了指导。我们的主要技术贡献是将随机矩阵的谱性质引入TI完全问题的算法中。这不仅导致了新的算法，也导致了有限域上随机矩阵理论中的新问题。为了解决这些问题，我们需要扩展Neumann和Praeger（J. London Math. Soc., 1998）的生成函数方法以及Gorodetsky和Rodgers（Trans. Amer. Math. Soc., 2021）的特征和方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一系列针对有限域上TI完全问题的高效平均情况算法，通过引入随机矩阵谱性质，显著提升了求解效率。
ai_comments: 该论文在张量同构（TI）复杂性领域做出了重要贡献。其核心创新点在于引入了有限域上随机矩阵的谱性质，为解决TI完全问题提供了一种新的算法视角。这一成果不仅改善了算法的平均情况性能，还加深了对这些问题复杂性景观的理解，对基于同构问题的密码学设计具有指导意义。
motivation: 针对TI完全问题（如代数同构、矩阵码共轭及4-张量同构）在有限域上的平均情况复杂性进行研究，以弥补以往算法在平均情况下运行时间过长的缺陷。
method: 将随机矩阵的谱性质应用于TI完全问题算法，并扩展了生成函数方法和特征和方法来解决相关的数学问题。
results: 开发出能在有限域上以一定概率多项式时间内求解代数同构、矩阵码共轭和4-张量同构的平均情况算法，在效率上优于以往的指数时间算法。
conclusion: 本文通过引入随机矩阵谱性质，为多种TI完全问题提供了多项式时间的平均情况算法，显著提升了该领域的算法研究水平。

title: More Human, More Efficient: Aligning Annotations with Quantized SLMs
authors: Jiayu Wang, Junyoung Lee
abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities advance, the demand for high-quality annotation of exponentially increasing text corpora has outpaced human capacity, leading to the widespread adoption of LLMs in automatic evaluation and annotation. However, proprietary LLMs often exhibit systematic biases that diverge from human expert consensus, lacks reproducibility, and raises data privacy concerns. Our work examines the viability of finetuning a quantized Small Language Model of 1.7B parameter size on limited human-annotated data to serve as a highly aligned, deterministic evaluator and annotator. By implementing a custom, multi-dimensional rubric framework and simple augmentation and regularization techniques, the proposed approach achieves higher inter-annotator agreement (0.23 points increase in Krippendorff's $α$) than the best performing state-of-the-art proprietary LLM. We also demonstrate the generalizability of the proposed training pipeline on a separate emotion classification task. The results show that task-specific alignment and efficient 4-bit quantized fine-tuning provide superior open-source alternative to using proprietary models for evaluation and annotation. Our finetuning approach is publicly available at https://github.com/jylee-k/slm-judge.
zh_title: 更人性化，更高效：将标注与量化小型语言模型对齐
translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）能力的提升，对呈指数级增长的文本语料库进行高质量标注的需求已超出人类能力，导致LLM在自动评估和标注中得到广泛应用。然而，专有LLM通常表现出与人类专家共识存在分歧的系统性偏差，缺乏可复现性，并引发数据隐私问题。我们的工作检验了在有限的人工标注数据上微调一个1.7B参数的量化小型语言模型（SLM）作为高度对齐、确定性评估器和标注器的可行性。通过实施自定义的多维度评分标准框架以及简单的增强和正则化技术，所提出的方法实现了比表现最佳的SOTA专有LLM更高的人际标注者一致性（Krippendorff's α 增加0.23点）。我们还展示了所提出的训练流程在单独的情感分类任务上的泛化能力。结果表明，任务特定的对齐和高效的4比特量化微调为使用专有模型进行评估和标注提供了优越的开源替代方案。我们的微调方法已在https://github.com/jylee-k/slm-judge 公开可用。
tldr: 本文提出通过在有限的人工标注数据上微调量化小型语言模型（SLM），实现比专有大型语言模型（LLM）更高的人际标注者一致性，为自动评估和标注提供了一种高效且更优的开源替代方案。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个高效且可复现的开源替代方案，以解决专有LLM在自动标注和评估中面临的挑战。通过在有限数据上微调量化SLM，它不仅提高了标注质量（更高的人际标注者一致性），还解决了专有模型的数据隐私和偏差问题。其泛化能力和开源性质使其具有重要实践意义。
motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）能力的提升，对高质量文本语料库标注的需求超出了人类能力。然而，专有LLM存在系统性偏差、缺乏可复现性并引发数据隐私问题，与人类专家共识存在分歧。
method: 通过在有限的人工标注数据上微调一个1.7B参数的量化小型语言模型（SLM），并实施自定义的多维度评分标准框架以及简单的增强和正则化技术。
results: 提出的方法实现了比表现最佳的SOTA专有LLM更高的人际标注者一致性（Krippendorff's α 增加0.23点），并证明了该训练流程在情感分类任务上的泛化能力。结果显示任务特定对齐和高效的4比特量化微调提供了优于专有模型的开源替代方案。
conclusion: 任务特定的对齐和高效的4比特量化微调为评估和标注提供了优越的开源替代方案，优于使用专有模型。

title: HarassGuard: Detecting Harassment Behaviors in Social Virtual Reality with Vision-Language Models
authors: Junhee Lee, Minseok Kim, Hwanjo Heo, Seungwon Woo, Jinwoo Kim
abstract: Social Virtual Reality (VR) platforms provide immersive social experiences but also expose users to serious risks of online harassment. Existing safety measures are largely reactive, while proactive solutions that detect harassment behavior during an incident often depend on sensitive biometric data, raising privacy concerns. In this paper, we present HarassGuard, a vision-language model (VLM) based system that detects physical harassment in social VR using only visual input. We construct an IRB-approved harassment vision dataset, apply prompt engineering, and fine-tune VLMs to detect harassment behavior by considering contextual information in social VR. Experimental results demonstrate that HarassGuard achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines (i.e., LSTM/CNN, Transformer), reaching an accuracy of up to 88.09% in binary classification and 68.85% in multi-class classification. Notably, HarassGuard matches these baselines while using significantly fewer fine-tuning samples (200 vs. 1,115), offering unique advantages in contextual reasoning and privacy-preserving detection.
comment: To appear in the 2026 TVCG Special Issue on the 2026 IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces (VR)
zh_title: HarassGuard：使用视觉-语言模型检测社交虚拟现实中的骚扰行为
translation: 社交虚拟现实（VR）平台提供沉浸式社交体验，但也使用户面临严重的在线骚扰风险。现有的安全措施大多是被动的，而事件发生时检测骚扰行为的主动解决方案通常依赖敏感的生物识别数据，引发了隐私问题。在本文中，我们提出了HarassGuard，一个基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的系统，它仅使用视觉输入来检测社交VR中的身体骚扰。我们构建了一个经IRB批准的骚扰视觉数据集，应用提示工程，并微调VLM，通过考虑社交VR中的上下文信息来检测骚扰行为。实验结果表明，与最先进的基线（即LSTM/CNN、Transformer）相比，HarassGuard取得了具有竞争力的性能，在二元分类中准确率高达88.09%，在多类别分类中准确率高达68.85%。值得注意的是，HarassGuard在使用的微调样本显著减少（200个对比1,115个）的情况下，性能与这些基线相当，在上下文推理和隐私保护检测方面提供了独特的优势。
tldr: HarassGuard是一个基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的系统，仅利用视觉输入检测社交VR中的身体骚扰行为，达到与SOTA基线相当的性能，且所需微调样本更少，具有隐私保护优势。

motivation: 社交VR平台存在严重的在线骚扰风险。现有安全措施多为被动响应，而主动检测骚扰行为的方案常依赖敏感生物识别数据，引发隐私担忧。
method: 提出HarassGuard系统，该系统基于视觉-语言模型（VLM），仅使用视觉输入检测社交VR中的身体骚扰。研究人员构建了一个经IRB批准的骚扰视觉数据集，应用提示工程（prompt engineering），并微调VLM以结合社交VR中的上下文信息来检测骚扰行为。
results: HarassGuard在二元分类中达到88.09%的准确率，在多类别分类中达到68.85%的准确率，与最先进的基线（如LSTM/CNN、Transformer）相比具有竞争性性能。值得注意的是，HarassGuard在显著减少微调样本（200个VS 1,115个）的情况下，性能与这些基线相当。
conclusion: HarassGuard系统能够有效且隐私友好地检测社交VR中的身体骚扰行为，通过VLM的上下文推理能力，在保持高性能的同时显著减少了对大量微调数据的依赖。

title: Agent psychometrics: Task-level performance prediction in agentic coding benchmarks
authors: Chris Ge, Daria Kryvosheieva, Daniel Fried, Uzay Girit, Kaivalya Hariharan
abstract: As the focus in LLM-based coding shifts from static single-step code generation to multi-step agentic interaction with tools and environments, understanding which tasks will challenge agents and why becomes increasingly difficult. This is compounded by current practice: agent performance is typically measured by aggregate pass rates on benchmarks, but single-number metrics obscure the diversity of tasks within a benchmark. We present a framework for predicting success or failure on individual tasks tailored to the agentic coding regime. Our approach augments Item Response Theory (IRT) with rich features extracted from tasks, including issue statements, repository contexts, solutions, and test cases, and introduces a novel decomposition of agent ability into LLM and scaffold ability components. This parameterization enables us to aggregate evaluation data across heterogeneous leaderboards and accurately predict task-level performance for unseen benchmarks, as well as unseen LLM-scaffold combinations. Our methods have practical utility for benchmark designers, who can better calibrate the difficulty of their new tasks without running computationally expensive agent evaluations.
zh_title: 智能体心理测量学：智能体编码基准中任务级别性能预测
translation: 随着基于大型语言模型（LLM）的编码焦点从静态单步代码生成转向与工具和环境进行多步智能体交互，理解哪些任务会挑战智能体以及原因变得越来越困难。当前实践中，智能体性能通常通过基准测试中的总通过率来衡量，但单一数字指标掩盖了基准测试中任务的多样性，这使得问题更加复杂。我们提出了一种框架，用于预测智能体编码体系中个体任务的成功或失败。我们的方法通过从任务中提取的丰富特征（包括问题陈述、仓库上下文、解决方案和测试用例）来增强项目反应理论（IRT），并引入了一种将智能体能力分解为LLM和支架能力组件的新颖方法。这种参数化使我们能够聚合来自异构排行榜的评估数据，并准确预测未见基准以及未见LLM-支架组合的任务级别性能。我们的方法对基准设计者具有实际效用，他们可以更好地校准新任务的难度，而无需运行计算成本高昂的智能体评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种预测大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体在多步编码任务中任务级别成功或失败的框架，通过结合项目反应理论（IRT）和丰富的任务特征，并分解智能体能力。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将心理测量学中的项目反应理论（IRT）引入到LLM智能体编码性能预测中，并结合了丰富的任务特征和能力分解。这种方法克服了传统聚合指标的局限性，能够提供更细粒度的任务级别性能预测。其对LLM和支架能力组件的分解，为理解智能体性能的来源提供了新视角。该研究对于基准测试的设计者具有重要实际意义，可以显著降低评估成本，并提升基准任务校准的效率和准确性。
motivation: 随着基于大型语言模型（LLM）的编码从静态单步代码生成转向与工具和环境进行多步智能体交互，理解哪些任务会挑战智能体以及原因变得越来越困难。当前的实践是，智能体性能通常通过基准测试中的总通过率来衡量，但单一数字指标掩盖了基准测试中任务的多样性。
method: 本文提出了一种预测智能体编码任务中个体任务成功或失败的框架。该方法通过从任务中提取的丰富特征（包括问题陈述、仓库上下文、解决方案和测试用例）来增强项目反应理论（IRT），并引入了一种将智能体能力分解为LLM和支架能力组件的新颖方法。
results: 这种参数化使我们能够聚合来自异构排行榜的评估数据，并准确预测未见基准以及未见LLM-支架组合的任务级别性能。我们的方法对基准设计者具有实际效用，他们可以更好地校准新任务的难度，而无需运行计算成本高昂的智能体评估。
conclusion: 本文提出的框架通过结合IRT和丰富的任务特征，并分解智能体能力，能够准确预测智能体在编码任务中的任务级别性能。这为基准设计者提供了一种无需昂贵评估即可校准任务难度的方法，从而提升了智能体编码基准的理解和设计。

title: Towards Viewpoint-Robust End-to-End Autonomous Driving with 3D Foundation Model Priors
authors: Hiroki Hashimoto, Hiromichi Goto, Hiroyuki Sugai, Hiroshi Kera, Kazuhiko Kawamoto
abstract: Robust trajectory planning under camera viewpoint changes is important for scalable end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing models often depend heavily on the camera viewpoints seen during training. We investigate an augmentation-free approach that leverages geometric priors from a 3D foundation model. The method injects per-pixel 3D positions derived from depth estimates as positional embeddings and fuses intermediate geometric features through cross-attention. Experiments on the VR-Drive camera viewpoint perturbation benchmark show reduced performance degradation under most perturbation conditions, with clear improvements under pitch and height perturbations. Gains under longitudinal translation are smaller, suggesting that more viewpoint-agnostic integration is needed for robustness to camera viewpoint changes.
comment: Accepted at CVPR Workshop on Simulation for Autonomous Driving 2026
zh_title: 迈向基于3D基础模型先验的视点鲁棒端到端自动驾驶
translation: 在摄像头视点变化下实现鲁棒的轨迹规划对于可扩展的端到端自动驾驶至关重要。然而，现有模型往往严重依赖于训练期间所见的摄像头视点。我们研究了一种无需增强的方法，该方法利用来自3D基础模型的几何先验。该方法将从深度估计中导出的每像素3D位置作为位置嵌入注入，并通过交叉注意力融合中间几何特征。在VR-Drive摄像头视点扰动基准上的实验表明，在大多数扰动条件下性能下降有所减少，在俯仰和高度扰动下有明显改善。在纵向平移下的增益较小，这表明需要更视点无关的集成以实现对摄像头视点变化的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用3D基础模型几何先验的增强型方法，以提高端到端自动驾驶在摄像头视点变化下的轨迹规划鲁棒性，并在VR-Drive基准测试中显示出对俯仰和高度扰动的显著改进。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过利用3D基础模型的几何先验，为解决端到端自动驾驶中摄像头视点鲁棒性问题提供了一个有前景的方向。其创新点在于无需数据增强，通过3D位置嵌入和交叉注意力融合特征，有效地提高了模型对视点变化的适应性。然而，对纵向平移鲁棒性提升有限，表明未来工作可以探索更深层次的视点无关集成策略。
motivation: 现有的端到端自动驾驶模型在摄像头视点变化时性能下降，严重依赖训练时见过的视点，因此需要一种更鲁棒的轨迹规划方法。
method: 该方法通过注入从深度估计中获得的每像素3D位置作为位置嵌入，并通过交叉注意力融合中间几何特征，利用3D基础模型中的几何先验，实现了一种无需数据增强的方法。
results: 实验表明，在VR-Drive摄像头视点扰动基准测试中，该方法在大多数扰动条件下减少了性能下降，尤其在俯仰和高度扰动下有明显改进。在纵向平移下的增益较小。
conclusion: 利用3D基础模型先验可以提高端到端自动驾驶对摄像头视点变化的鲁棒性，尤其是在俯仰和高度扰动方面。然而，对于纵向平移等情况，仍需要更视点无关的集成方法。

title: Predicting Dynamics of Ultra-Large Complex Systems by Inferring Governing Equations
authors: Qi Shao, Duxin Chen, Jiawen Chen, Yujie Zeng, Athen Ma, Wenwu Yu, Vito Latora, Wei Lin
abstract: Predicting the behavior of ultra-large complex systems, from climate to biological and technological networks, is a central unsolved challenge. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: equation discovery methods provide interpretability but fail to scale, while neural networks scale but operate as black boxes and often lose reliability over long times. Here, we introduce the Sparse Identification Graph Neural Network, a framework that overcome this divide by allowing to infer the governing equations of large networked systems from data. By defining symbolic discovery as edge-level information, SIGN decouples the scalability of sparse identification from network size, enabling efficient equation discovery even in large systems. SIGN allows to study networks with over 100,000 nodes while remaining robust to noise, sparse sampling, and missing data. Across diverse benchmark systems, including coupled chaotic oscillators, neural dynamics, and epidemic spreading, it recovers governing equations with high precision and sustains accurate long-term predictions. Applied to a data set of time series of temperature measurements in 71,987 sea surface positions, SIGN identifies a compact predictive network model and captures large-scale sea surface temperature conditions up to two years in advance. By enabling equation discovery at previously inaccessible scales, SIGN opens a path toward interpretable and reliable prediction of real-world complex systems.
zh_title: 通过推断控制方程预测超大型复杂系统的动力学
translation: 预测超大型复杂系统（从气候到生物和技术网络）的行为是一个核心的未解决挑战。现有方法面临一个根本性权衡：方程发现方法提供可解释性但无法扩展，而神经网络可扩展但作为黑箱运行且长期可靠性差。在这里，我们引入了稀疏识别图神经网络（Sparse Identification Graph Neural Network, SIGN），这是一个通过允许从数据中推断大型网络系统的控制方程来克服这一鸿沟的框架。通过将符号发现定义为边级信息，SIGN将稀疏识别的可扩展性与网络大小解耦，从而即使在大型系统中也能实现高效的方程发现。SIGN允许研究拥有超过100,000个节点的网络，同时对噪声、稀疏采样和缺失数据保持鲁棒性。在包括耦合混沌振荡器、神经动力学和流行病传播在内的多种基准系统中，它以高精度恢复了控制方程并维持了准确的长期预测。应用于71,987个海面位置的温度测量时间序列数据集时，SIGN识别出一个紧凑的预测网络模型，并提前两年捕捉到大规模海面温度状况。通过在以前无法达到的规模上实现方程发现，SIGN为真实世界复杂系统的可解释和可靠预测开辟了一条道路。
tldr: SIGN（稀疏识别图神经网络）是一种新框架，通过将符号发现定义为边级信息，解决了现有方法在预测超大型复杂系统（如气候和生物网络）动力学时面临的可解释性和可扩展性之间的权衡。它能从数据中推断大型网络系统的控制方程，在高达100,000个节点的系统上实现高效方程发现，并能进行准确的长期预测。
ai_comments: SIGN的创新之处在于它巧妙地将符号发现与图神经网络结合，克服了传统方程发现方法在处理大规模复杂系统时的可扩展性限制，同时保留了模型的可解释性，这在气候、生物等关键领域具有重要意义。它为“黑箱”模型与传统物理建模之间架起了一座桥梁。
motivation: 预测超大型复杂系统（如气候、生物和技术网络）的行为是一个尚未解决的核心挑战。现有方法面临一个根本性权衡：方程发现方法提供可解释性但无法扩展，而神经网络可扩展但作为黑箱运行且长期可靠性差。
method: 本文引入了稀疏识别图神经网络（SIGN）框架。SIGN通过将符号发现定义为边级信息，将稀疏识别的可扩展性与网络大小解耦，从而克服了方程发现方法和神经网络之间的局限性。这使得即使在大型系统中也能高效地推断控制方程。
results: SIGN能够研究拥有超过100,000个节点的网络，同时对噪声、稀疏采样和缺失数据保持鲁棒性。它在包括耦合混沌振荡器、神经动力学和流行病传播在内的多种基准系统中，以高精度恢复了控制方程并维持了准确的长期预测。应用于71,987个海面位置的温度测量时间序列数据集时，SIGN识别出一个紧凑的预测网络模型，并提前两年捕捉到大规模海面温度状况。
conclusion: SIGN通过在以前无法达到的规模上实现方程发现，为真实世界复杂系统的可解释和可靠预测开辟了一条道路。

title: MPI-Q: A Message Communication Library for Large-Scale Classical-Quantum Heterogeneous Hybrid Distributed Computing
authors: Feng Wang, Junchao Wang, Zeyuan Wang, Lei Li, Yangyang Fei, Jinyang Yao, Xuyan Qi, Fudong Liu, Yifan Hou, Shibo Liang, Zheng Shan
abstract:
The classical-quantum system heterogeneity (different data characteristics, execution paradigms and synchronization mechanism etc.) renders existing distributed communication mechanisms (e.g. MPI, NCCL etc.) inadequate. This bottleneck severely impairs operational synergy and programming efficiency. Thus, the performance of hybrid applications on classical-quantum heterogeneous infrastructures is directly limited.
  To address these challenges, this paper proposes a message-passing library tailored for large-scale classical-quantum heterogeneous distributed computing, referred to as MPI-Q. The design centers on three mechanisms. First, it defines a heterogeneous hybrid communication domain that achieves unified management of classical and quantum processes in heterogeneous hybrid systems. Second, it uses a lightweight communication path that allows classical control nodes to send device-ready waveform data directly to quantum MonitorProcesses, avoiding unnecessary relay stages. Third, it establishes a heterogeneous hybrid synchronization mechanism to tackle the problem of timing control for multi-node quantum operations. While retaining the traditional MPI programming model, MPI-Q achieves extension toward quantum subsystems. Experiments on distributed GHZ state preparation demonstrate that this model exhibits near-linear scalability, achieving a maximum speedup of 18.76 times on 24 quantum nodes. This proves that the library can effectively support large-scale heterogeneous hybrid distributed computing applications, filling the technical gap in this field.
zh_title: MPI-Q：一个用于大规模经典-量子异构混合分布式计算的消息通信库
translation:
经典-量子系统的异构性（数据特性、执行范式和同步机制等不同）使得现有的分布式通信机制（例如 MPI、NCCL 等）不足。这种瓶颈严重影响了操作协同和编程效率。因此，混合应用程序在经典-量子异构基础设施上的性能受到直接限制。
 为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一个专为大规模经典-量子异构分布式计算量身定制的消息传递库，称为 MPI-Q。该设计围绕三个机制展开。首先，它定义了一个异构混合通信域，该通信域在异构混合系统中实现了经典和量子进程的统一管理。其次，它使用轻量级的通信路径，允许经典控制节点直接将设备就绪的波形数据发送到量子监视器进程，从而避免了不必要的中继阶段。第三，它建立了异构混合同步机制来解决多节点量子操作的时序控制问题。在保留传统的 MPI 编程模型的同时，MPI-Q 实现了向量子子系统的扩展。分布式 GHZ 态制备实验表明，该模型表现出近乎线性的可扩展性，在 24 个量子节点上实现了高达 18.76 倍的加速比。这证明了该库能够有效支持大规模异构混合分布式计算应用程序，填补了该领域的技术空白。
tldr: 本研究提出MPI-Q，一个为大规模经典-量子异构混合分布式计算设计的新消息传递库，通过异构混合通信域、轻量级通信路径和异构混合同步机制，解决了现有通信库的不足，提高了经典-量子系统的协同操作和编程效率，并在GHZ态制备实验中展示了近乎线性的可扩展性和显著的加速比。
ai_comments: MPI-Q库的提出解决了经典-量子混合计算领域的一个关键瓶颈，即通信效率低下。其创新的异构通信域和轻量级通信路径设计，以及对量子操作时序控制的关注，都体现了针对该特定领域需求的深度优化。然而，该研究的局限性可能在于其在更广泛的量子计算任务和不同硬件平台上的通用性和性能验证，以及其与新兴的量子通信协议的潜在比较。
motivation: 现有的分布式通信机制（如MPI、NCCL等）在处理经典-量子系统异构性（数据特性、执行范式、同步机制等不同）方面存在不足，严重制约了混合应用的性能和编程效率。
method: 提出MPI-Q库，包含三个核心机制：1. 定义异构混合通信域，统一管理经典和量子进程；2. 使用轻量级通信路径，允许经典控制节点直接向量子MonitorProcesses发送数据；3. 建立异构混合同步机制，解决多节点量子操作的时序控制问题。
results: 在分布式GHZ态制备实验中，MPI-Q展示了近乎线性的可扩展性，在24个量子节点上实现了高达18.76倍的加速比。
conclusion: MPI-Q库能够有效支持大规模异构混合分布式计算应用，填补了该领域的技术空白。

title: Speech LLMs are Contextual Reasoning Transcribers
authors: Keqi Deng, Ruchao Fan, Bo Ren, Yiming Wang, Jinyu Li
abstract: Despite extensions to speech inputs, effectively leveraging the rich knowledge and contextual understanding of large language models (LLMs) in automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains non-trivial, as the task primarily involves direct speech-to-text mapping. To address this, this paper proposes chain-of-thought ASR (CoT-ASR), which constructs a reasoning chain that enables LLMs to first analyze the input speech and generate contextual analysis, thereby fully exploiting their generative capabilities. With this contextual reasoning, CoT-ASR then performs more informed speech recognition and completes both reasoning and transcription in a single pass. Moreover, CoT-ASR naturally supports user-guided transcription: while designed to self-generate reasoning, it can also seamlessly incorporate user-provided context to guide transcription, further extending ASR functionality. To reduce the modality gap, this paper introduces a CTC-guided Modality Adapter, which uses CTC non-blank token probabilities to weight LLM embeddings, efficiently aligning speech encoder outputs with the LLM's textual latent space. Experiments show that, compared to standard LLM-based ASR, CoT-ASR achieves a relative reduction of 8.7% in word error rate (WER) and 16.9% in entity error rate (EER).
zh_title: 语音大模型是上下文推理转录器
translation: 尽管已经扩展到语音输入，但在自动语音识别（ASR）中有效利用大语言模型（LLMs）的丰富知识和上下文理解能力仍然并非易事，因为该任务主要涉及直接的语音到文本映射。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了思维链ASR（CoT-ASR），它构建了一个推理链，使LLMs能够首先分析输入语音并生成上下文分析，从而充分利用其生成能力。有了这种上下文推理，CoT-ASR随后执行更明智的语音识别，并在单次传递中完成推理和转录。此外，CoT-ASR自然支持用户引导的转录：虽然设计为自生成推理，但它也可以无缝结合用户提供的上下文来指导转录，进一步扩展了ASR功能。为了减少模态差距，本文引入了一个CTC引导的模态适配器，它使用CTC非空标记概率来加权LLM嵌入，有效地将语音编码器输出与LLM的文本潜在空间对齐。实验表明，与基于标准LLM的ASR相比，CoT-ASR在词错误率（WER）上实现了8.7%的相对降低，在实体错误率（EER）上实现了16.9%的相对降低。
tldr: 通过引入思维链推理和CTC模态适配，CoT-ASR框架显著提升了语音识别的准确性及上下文理解能力。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入思维链（CoT）机制，巧妙地将自动语音识别（ASR）任务从简单的“映射”转变为“理解与生成”过程，这是LLM在语音领域应用的重要范式转变。其CTC引导的模态适配器有效解决了多模态对齐难题，具有较高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的语音LLM多将任务视为简单的直接映射，未能充分利用LLM强大的知识储备和上下文理解能力，导致在复杂场景下的识别效果受限。
method: 1. 提出链式思维ASR（CoT-ASR），让模型在转录前先生成上下文分析；2. 引入CTC引导的模态适配器，利用CTC非空标记概率对LLM嵌入进行加权，实现语音编码器与LLM文本空间的对齐。
results: 与标准LLM-based ASR相比，CoT-ASR在词错误率（WER）上相对降低了8.7%，在实体错误率（EER）上相对降低了16.9%。
conclusion: CoT-ASR通过思维链推理和CTC引导的模态适配，显著提升了语音识别的准确性，尤其是上下文理解能力和实体识别率，为语音与大模型的深度融合提供了新思路。

title: Fluently Lying: Adversarial Robustness Can Be Substrate-Dependent
authors: Daye Kang, Hyeongboo Baek
abstract: The primary tools used to monitor and defend object detectors under adversarial attack assume that when accuracy degrades, detection count drops in tandem. This coupling was assumed, not measured. We report a counterexample observed on a single model: under standard PGD, EMS-YOLO, a spiking neural network (SNN) object detector, retains more than 70% of its detections while mAP collapses from 0.528 to 0.042. We term this count-preserving accuracy collapse Quality Corruption (QC), to distinguish it from the suppression that dominates untargeted evaluation. Across four SNN architectures and two threat models (l-infinity and l-2), QC appears only in one of the four detectors tested (EMS-YOLO). On this model, all five standard defense components fail to detect or mitigate QC, suggesting the defense ecosystem may rely on a shared assumption calibrated on a single substrate. These results provide, to our knowledge, the first evidence that adversarial failure modes can be substrate-dependent.
zh_title: 流利地说谎：对抗鲁棒性可能具有底物依赖性
translation: 用于监控和防御对抗攻击下对象检测器的主要工具均假设：当精度下降时，检测数量会同步下降。这种耦合关系是被假设而非被测量出来的。我们报告了一个在单一模型上观察到的反例：在标准PGD攻击下，脉冲神经网络（SNN）对象检测器EMS-YOLO在mAP从0.528崩溃到0.042时，仍保留了超过70%的检测结果。我们将这种保持数量但精度崩溃的现象称为“质量退化”（Quality Corruption, QC），以区别于无目标评估中占主导地位的抑制现象。在四种SNN架构和两种威胁模型（l-infinity和l-2）的测试中，QC仅出现在其中一个检测器（EMS-YOLO）上。在该模型上，所有五种标准防御组件均未能检测或缓解QC，这表明防御生态系统可能依赖于基于单一计算底物校准的共同假设。据我们所知，这些结果首次证明了对抗性失效模式可能具有底物依赖性。
tldr: 研究发现脉冲神经网络（SNN）在对抗攻击下会出现一种名为“质量退化”的新型失效模式，即检测精度崩溃但检测数量保持不变，这证明了现有的防御手段在不同计算底物上可能失效。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了一个重要的盲点：现有的对抗防御机制主要基于传统人工神经网络（ANN）的假设构建，而忽视了脉冲神经网络（SNN）可能存在的独特失效模式（质量退化而非数量减少）。这一发现挑战了现有防御生态系统的通用性，提醒研究者在评估不同计算架构的鲁棒性时需更加审慎。
motivation: 现有的对象检测器监控和防御工具普遍假设精度下降必然伴随着检测数量的减少，但这一假设缺乏实证支持，且未考虑到不同计算底物（如SNN）可能存在不同的失效机制。
method: 通过在四种SNN架构上应用两种威胁模型（l-infinity和l-2），测试标准PGD攻击下的模型表现，并对比检测数量与mAP（平均精度均值）的变化。
results: 研究发现了一种名为“质量退化”（Quality Corruption, QC）的现象，即在EMS-YOLO模型中，mAP从0.528大幅降至0.042时，检测数量仍能保留超过70%。此外，现有的五种标准防御组件均未能检测或缓解该现象。
conclusion: 对抗性失效模式具有底物依赖性（substrate-dependent），现有的防御手段在应对特定SNN架构产生的“质量退化”现象时可能完全失效。

title: TALENT: Target-aware Efficient Tuning for Referring Image Segmentation
authors: Shuo Jin, Siyue Yu, Bingfeng Zhang, Chao Yao, Meiqin Liu, Jimin Xiao
abstract: Referring image segmentation aims to segment specific targets based on a natural text expression. Recently, parameter-efficient tuning (PET) has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, existing PET-based methods often suffer from the fact that visual features can't emphasize the text-referred target instance but activate co-category yet unrelated objects. We analyze and quantify this problem, terming it the `non-target activation' (NTA) issue. To address this, we propose a novel framework, TALENT, which utilizes target-aware efficient tuning for PET-based RIS. Specifically, we first propose a Rectified Cost Aggregator (RCA) to efficiently aggregate text-referred features. Then, to calibrate `NTA' into accurate target activation, we adopt a Target-aware Learning Mechanism (TLM), including contextual pairwise consistency learning and target-centric contrastive learning. The former uses the sentence-level text feature to achieve a holistic understanding of the referent and constructs a text-referred affinity map to optimize the semantic association of visual features. The latter further enhances target localization to discover the distinct instance while suppressing associations with other unrelated ones. The two objectives work in concert and address `NTA' effectively. Extensive evaluations show that TALENT outperforms existing methods across various metrics (e.g., 2.5\% mIoU gains on G-Ref val set). Our codes will be released at: https://github.com/Kimsure/TALENT.
zh_title: TALENT: 目标感知的高效微调用于指代图像分割
translation: 指代图像分割旨在根据自然语言文本表达式分割特定目标。最近，参数高效微调（PET）已成为一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的基于PET的方法常常面临视觉特征无法强调文本线索指向的目标实例，反而激活了同类但无关的物体。我们分析并量化了这个问题，称之为“非目标激活”（NTA）问题。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个新颖的框架，TALENT，它利用目标感知的高效微调来进行基于PET的RIS。具体来说，我们首先提出了一个校正成本聚合器（RCA）来高效地聚合文本线索特征。然后，为了将“NTA”校准为准确的目标激活，我们采用了一个目标感知学习机制（TLM），包括上下文成对一致性学习和目标中心对比学习。前者利用句子级文本特征进行整体理解，并构建文本线索亲和力图来优化视觉特征的语义关联。后者进一步增强目标定位，以发现不同的实例，同时抑制与其他无关物体的关联。这两种目标协同工作，有效解决了“NTA”问题。大量的评估表明，TALENT在各项指标上均优于现有方法（例如，在G-Ref验证集上mIoU提升2.5%）。我们的代码将在：https://github.com/Kimsure/TALENT发布。
tldr: 现有参数高效微调（PET）方法在指代图像分割（RIS）中存在“非目标激活”（NTA）问题，即视觉特征激活了不相关的同类物体。TALENT框架通过目标感知的高效微调来解决此问题，提出了一种校正成本聚合器（RCA）来聚合文本线索特征，并采用目标感知学习机制（TLM），包括上下文成对一致性学习和目标中心对比学习，以校准NTA并提高目标定位精度。TALENT在各项指标上均优于现有方法，并在G-Ref验证集上实现了2.5%的mIoU提升。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种名为TALENT的新框架，用于解决指代图像分割中现有的参数高效微调方法所面临的“非目标激活”问题。通过引入校正成本聚合器（RCA）和目标感知学习机制（TLM），该方法能够更精确地定位目标，并抑制无关物体的激活。研究结果显示出显著的性能提升，表明该方法在指代图像分割领域具有重要的应用价值和创新性。
motivation: 现有参数高效微调（PET）方法在指代图像分割（RIS）中存在“非目标激活”（NTA）问题，即视觉特征倾向于激活与文本线索相关的同类物体，而非精确的目标实例。
method: TALENT框架引入了目标感知的高效微调。具体包括：1. 校正成本聚合器（RCA），用于高效聚合文本线索特征。2. 目标感知学习机制（TLM），包含上下文成对一致性学习（利用句子级文本特征进行整体理解，并构建文本线索亲和力图优化视觉特征的语义关联）和目标中心对比学习（增强目标定位，区分实例并抑制不相关联想）。
results: TALENT在各项指标上均优于现有方法，并在G-Ref验证集上取得了2.5%的mIoU提升。
conclusion: TALENT通过引入目标感知的高效微调，有效解决了指代图像分割中的“非目标激活”问题，并在实验中取得了显著的性能提升。

title: KG-CMI: Knowledge graph enhanced cross-Mamba interaction for medical visual question answering
authors: Xianyao Zheng, Hong Yu, Hui Cui, Changming Sun, Xiangyu Li, Ran Su, Leyi Wei, Jia Zhou, Junbo Wang, Qiangguo Jin
abstract: Medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) is a crucial multimodal task in clinical decision support and telemedicine. Recent methods fail to fully leverage domain-specific medical knowledge, making it difficult to accurately associate lesion features in medical images with key diagnostic criteria. Additionally, classification-based approaches typically rely on predefined answer sets. Treating Med-VQA as a simple classification problem limits its ability to adapt to the diversity of free-form answers and may overlook detailed semantic information in those answers. To address these challenges, we propose a knowledge graph enhanced cross-Mamba interaction (KG-CMI) framework, which consists of a fine-grained cross-modal feature alignment (FCFA) module, a knowledge graph embedding (KGE) module, a cross-modal interaction representation (CMIR) module, and a free-form answer enhanced multi-task learning (FAMT) module. The KG-CMI learns cross-modal feature representations for images and texts by effectively integrating professional medical knowledge through a graph, establishing associations between lesion features and disease knowledge. Moreover, FAMT leverages auxiliary knowledge from open-ended questions, improving the model's capability for open-ended Med-VQA. Experimental results demonstrate that KG-CMI outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods on three Med-VQA datasets, i.e., VQA-RAD, SLAKE, and OVQA. Additionally, we conduct interpretability experiments to further validate the framework's effectiveness.
zh_title: 用于医学视觉问答的知识图谱增强交叉-Mamba交互
translation: 医学视觉问答（Med-VQA）是临床决策支持和远程医疗中的一项关键多模态任务。现有方法未能充分利用领域特定的医学知识，使得准确关联医学图像中的病灶特征与关键诊断标准变得困难。此外，基于分类的方法通常依赖于预定义的答案集。将Med-VQA视为一个简单的分类问题限制了其适应自由形式答案多样性的能力，并可能忽略答案中的详细语义信息。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一个知识图谱增强交叉-Mamba交互（KG-CMI）框架，该框架由细粒度跨模态特征对齐（FCFA）模块、知识图谱嵌入（KGE）模块、跨模态交互表示（CMIR）模块和自由形式答案增强多任务学习（FAMT）模块组成。KG-CMI通过图谱有效地整合专业医学知识，学习图像和文本的跨模态特征表示，建立病灶特征与疾病知识之间的关联。此外，FAMT利用开放式问题的辅助知识，提高了模型处理开放式Med-VQA的能力。实验结果表明，KG-CMI在VQA-RAD、SLAKE和OVQA三个Med-VQA数据集上的表现优于现有的最先进方法。此外，我们进行了可解释性实验，以进一步验证该框架的有效性。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为KG-CMI的框架，通过结合医学知识图谱和交叉-Mamba交互来改进医学视觉问答（Med-VQA）。该框架解决了现有方法未能充分利用领域知识和处理自由形式答案的局限性。KG-CMI通过多模块设计，实现了细粒度的跨模态特征对齐、知识图谱嵌入、跨模态交互表示，并利用多任务学习处理自由形式答案。实验证明，KG-CMI在三个Med-VQA数据集上优于现有最先进方法。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的KG-CMI框架，通过结合知识图谱和交叉-Mamba交互来解决Med-VQA中的关键问题，特别是知识利用和自由形式答案处理方面。框架的多模块设计和跨模态特征对齐是其亮点。然而，对于大规模医学知识图谱的构建和维护成本，以及模型在真实临床环境中的部署和泛化能力仍需进一步研究。
motivation: 现有的医学视觉问答（Med-VQA）方法未能充分利用领域特定的医学知识，难以准确地将医学图像中的病灶特征与关键诊断标准相关联。此外，基于分类的方法依赖于预定义的答案集，限制了其处理自由形式答案和捕捉详细语义信息的能力。
method: 提出了一种名为KG-CMI（知识图谱增强交叉-Mamba交互）的框架，该框架包含四个模块：细粒度跨模态特征对齐（FCFA）、知识图谱嵌入（KGE）、跨模态交互表示（CMIR）和自由形式答案增强多任务学习（FAMT）。KG-CMI通过图谱整合专业医学知识，建立病灶特征与疾病知识之间的联系，并利用辅助知识提高模型处理开放式Med-VQA的能力。
results: KG-CMI框架在VQA-RAD、SLAKE和OVQA三个Med-VQA数据集上取得了优于现有最先进方法的性能。此外，解释性实验进一步验证了该框架的有效性。
conclusion: KG-CMI框架通过整合医学知识图谱和创新的交叉-Mamba交互机制，有效解决了Med-VQA中的关键挑战，显著提升了模型在处理医学图像和文本信息时的准确性和灵活性，尤其在处理自由形式答案方面表现出色。

title: English to Central Kurdish Speech Translation: Corpus Creation, Evaluation, and Orthographic Standardization
authors: Mohammad Mohammadamini, Daban Q. Jaff, Josep Crego, Marie Tahon, Antoine Laurent
abstract: We present KUTED, a speech-to-text translation (S2TT) dataset for Central Kurdish, derived from TED and TEDx talks. The corpus comprises 91,000 sentence pairs, including 170 hours of English audio, 1.65 million English tokens, and 1.40 million Central Kurdish tokens. We evaluate KUTED on the S2TT task and find that orthographic variation significantly degrades Kurdish translation performance, producing nonstandard outputs. To address this, we propose a systematic text standardization approach that yields substantial performance gains and more consistent translations. On a test set separated from TED talks, a fine-tuned Seamless model achieves 15.18 BLEU, and we improve Seamless baseline by 3.0 BLEU on the FLEURS benchmark. We also train a Transformer model from scratch and evaluate a cascaded system that combines Seamless (ASR) with NLLB (MT).
zh_title: 英语到中央库尔德语的语音翻译：语料库创建、评估与正字法标准化
translation: 我们提出了KUTED，这是一个源自TED和TEDx演讲的中央库尔德语语音到文本翻译（S2TT）数据集。该语料库包含91,000个句子对，包括170小时的英语音频、165万个英语标记和140万个中央库尔德语标记。我们在S2TT任务上评估了KUTED，发现正字法差异会显著降低库尔德语的翻译性能，产生非标准输出。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种系统性的文本标准化方法，该方法带来了实质性的性能提升和更一致的翻译。在从TED演讲中分离出的测试集上，微调后的Seamless模型达到了15.18 BLEU，并且我们在FLEURS基准测试上将Seamless基准提高了3.0 BLEU。我们还从头训练了一个Transformer模型，并评估了一个结合了Seamless（ASR）和NLLB（MT）的级联系统。
tldr: 本文构建了中央库尔德语语音翻译数据集KUTED，并提出正字法标准化方案，显著提升了模型翻译性能。
ai_comments: 该论文不仅构建了一个重要的低资源语言数据集，还针对库尔德语正字法不规范这一关键痛点提出了系统性的标准化方案，对低资源语言的语音翻译研究具有重要的参考价值。
motivation: 中央库尔德语缺乏高质量的语音翻译数据集，且正字法不规范严重影响了翻译质量。
method: 构建了包含9.1万句对的KUTED数据集；采用系统性的文本标准化方法处理库尔德语正字法变体；基于Seamless模型进行微调，并评估了Transformer模型和级联系统（Seamless+NLLB）。
results: KUTED数据集在测试集上使微调后的Seamless模型达到15.18 BLEU，并在FLEURS基准测试中将基准性能提升了3.0 BLEU。
conclusion: KUTED 数据集有效填补了中央库尔德语语音翻译资源的空白，通过正字法标准化处理，显著提升了翻译模型的性能。

title: Heterogeneous Mean Field Game Framework for LEO Satellite-Assisted V2X Networks
authors: Kangkang Sun, Jianhua Li, Xiuzhen Chen, Minyi Guo
abstract: Coordinating mixed fleets of $10^4$ to $10^5$ vehicles, passenger cars, freight trucks, and autonomous vehicles, under stringent delay constraints is a central scalability bottleneck in next-generation V2X networks. Heterogeneous mean field games (HMFG) offer a principled coordination framework, yet a fundamental design question lacks theoretical guidance: how many agent types $K$ should be used for a fleet of size $N$? The core challenge is a two-sided trade-off that existing theory does not resolve: increasing $K$ reduces type-discretization error but simultaneously starves each class of the samples needed for reliable mean-field approximation. We resolve this trade-off by deriving an explicit $\varepsilon$-Nash error decomposition driven by a Wasserstein-based heterogeneity measure, and prove that the unique error-minimizing type count satisfies $K^*(N)=Θ(N^{1/3})$ in the canonical one-dimensional queue setting. We further establish a heterogeneity-aware convergence condition for G-prox PDHG and extend the framework to temporal-graph LEO satellite backhaul dynamics with provable robustness guarantees. A perhaps surprising consequence is that even for $N=10^5$ vehicles, only about 28 type classes suffice, cube-root compression rather than per-vehicle modeling, so type-granularity selection is largely a set-once design decision. Experiments validate the scaling law, achieve $2.3\times$ faster PDHG convergence at $K=5$, and deliver up to $29.5\%$ lower delay and $60\%$ higher throughput compared with homogeneous baselines.
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, has been submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
zh_title: 面向LEO卫星辅助V2X网络的异构平均场博弈框架
translation: 协调由 $10^4$ 到 $10^5$ 辆乘用车、货车和自动驾驶汽车组成的混合车队，在严格的延迟约束下是下一代V2X网络的核心可扩展性瓶颈。异构平均场博弈（HMFG）提供了一个原则性的协调框架，但一个基础的设计问题缺乏理论指导：对于规模为 $N$ 的车队，应该使用多少种代理类型 $K$？核心挑战在于现有理论尚未解决的双向权衡：增加 $K$ 会减少类型离散化误差，但同时会使每个类别缺乏可靠平均场近似所需的样本。我们通过推导基于Wasserstein异构度量的显式 $\varepsilon$-Nash 误差分解解决了这一权衡，并证明在规范的一维队列设置中，唯一的误差最小化类型数量满足 $K^*(N)=Θ(N^{1/3})$。我们进一步建立了 G-prox PDHG 的异构感知收敛条件，并将该框架扩展到具有可证明鲁棒性保证的时间图LEO卫星回传动态中。一个令人惊讶的结果是，即使对于 $N=10^5$ 辆车，仅需约28个类型类就足够了，这种立方根压缩而非逐车建模的方式，使得类型粒度选择在很大程度上成为一次性的设计决策。实验验证了该缩放定律，在 $K=5$ 时实现了 2.3 倍的 PDHG 收敛速度，并与同质基准相比，延迟降低了高达 29.5%，吞吐量提高了 60%。
tldr: 本文揭示了大规模V2X网络中代理类型数量与总体规模的缩放定律（$K \propto N^{1/3}$），证明了通过有限的类型划分即可实现复杂系统的高效协同，显著降低了计算复杂性并优化了网络性能。
ai_comments: 该论文通过理论推导解决了异构平均场博弈（HMFG）中代理类型数量 $K$ 与总体规模 $N$ 之间的权衡难题，提出了 $K^*(N)=Θ(N^{1/3})$ 的缩放定律。这一发现极大地简化了大规模车联网（V2X）系统的设计复杂度，证明了即使在海量车辆场景下，有限的类型划分也足以实现高效协同，具有重要的工程指导意义。
motivation: 大规模V2X网络中，由于车辆类型繁多（私家车、卡车、自动驾驶车等），且存在严格的延迟约束，如何确定合理的代理类型数量 $K$ 以平衡离散化误差与样本稀疏性带来的模型偏差，是目前理论上的核心瓶颈。
method: 构建了异构平均场博弈（HMFG）框架；利用Wasserstein度量推导了 $\varepsilon$-Nash 误差分解；证明了最优类型数量满足 $K^*(N)=Θ(N^{1/3})$；提出了针对 G-prox PDHG 的异构感知收敛条件，并将其扩展至LEO卫星回传网络。
results: 理论证明了最优类型数量 $K^* \approx N^{1/3}$；实验表明对于 $N=10^5$ 的车辆规模，仅需约28种类型即可达到最优；该方法在实验中使 PDHG 收敛速度提升了 2.3 倍，延迟降低了 29.5%，吞吐量提升了 60%。
conclusion: 通过引入基于Wasserstein度量的误差分解，证明了最优类型数量遵循 $K^*(N)=Θ(N^{1/3})$ 的缩放规律，在保证系统性能的同时大幅降低了模型复杂度，为大规模V2X网络协同提供了理论基础与实践指导。

title: A Physical Imitation Learning Pipeline for Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion Assisted by Parallel Elastic Joint
authors: Huyue Ma, Yurui Jin, Helmut Hauser, Rui Wu
abstract: Due to brain-body co-evolution, animals' intrinsic body dynamics play a crucial role in energy-efficient locomotion, which shares control effort between active muscles and passive body dynamics -- a principle known as Embodied Physical Intelligence. In contrast, robot bodies are often designed with one centralised controller that typically suppress the intrinsic body dynamics instead of exploiting it. We introduce Physical Imitation Learning (PIL), which distils a Reinforcement Learning (RL) control policy into physically implementable body responses that can be directly offloaded to passive Parallel Elastic Joints (PEJs), enabling therefore the body to imitate part of the controlled behaviour. Meanwhile, the residual policy commands the motors to recover the RL policy's performance. The results is an overall reduced energy consumption thanks to outsourcing parts of the control policy to the PEJs. Here we show in simulated quadrupeds, that our PIL approach can offloads up to 87% of mechanical power to PEJs on flat terrain and 18% on rough terrain. Because the body design is distilled from -- rather than jointly optimised with -- the control policy, PIL realises brain-body co-design without expanding the search space with body design parameters, providing a computationally efficient route to task-specific Embodied Physical Intelligence applicable to a wide range of joint-based robot morphologies.
zh_title: 用于并联弹性关节辅助的节能型四足机器人运动的物理模仿学习管线
translation: 由于大脑-身体的协同进化，动物的内在身体动力学在节能运动中起着至关重要的作用，它在主动肌肉和被动身体动力学之间分担控制工作——这一原理被称为具身物理智能。相比之下，机器人身体通常采用单一的中央控制器进行设计，该控制器通常会抑制内在身体动力学，而不是加以利用。我们引入了物理模仿学习（PIL），它将强化学习（RL）控制策略蒸馏成物理上可实现的身体响应，可以直接卸载到被动的并联弹性关节（PEJs），从而使身体能够模仿部分控制行为。同时，剩余的策略命令电机以恢复RL策略的性能。其结果是，由于将部分控制策略外包给了PEJs，整体能源消耗有所降低。我们在此模拟的四足机器人上表明，我们的PIL方法在平坦地形上可以将高达87%的机械功率卸载到PEJs，在崎岖地形上可以卸载18%。由于身体设计是从控制策略中蒸馏出来的，而不是与控制策略联合优化的，PIL实现了脑体协同设计，而没有通过身体设计参数扩展搜索空间，为适用于各种关节式机器人形态的任务特定具身物理智能提供了一条计算高效的途径。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种物理模仿学习（PIL）方法，将强化学习（RL）控制策略转化为物理上可实现的身体响应，并利用并联弹性关节（PEJs）来模仿部分控制行为，从而减少能源消耗。该方法在模拟四足机器人上进行了验证，显示在平坦地形上可将高达87%的机械功率转移到PEJs，在崎岖地形上可转移18%。PIL通过在不扩展搜索空间的情况下实现脑体协同设计，为机器人形态提供了高效的任务特定具身物理智能实现途径。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的物理模仿学习（PIL）方法在利用机器人内在身体动力学以实现节能运动方面具有创新性。通过将控制策略的一部分卸载到并联弹性关节（PEJs），PIL有效地降低了能源消耗，并在模拟实验中得到了验证。该方法避免了联合优化带来的计算复杂性，为实现任务特定的具身物理智能提供了一条高效的途径。然而，该研究主要在模拟环境中进行，未来的工作可以进一步探索在真实机器人上的应用效果和鲁棒性。
motivation: 动物通过利用内在身体动力学来实现节能运动，而机器人通常抑制这种动力学。本研究旨在开发一种能利用机器人内在身体动力学以实现节能运动的方法。
method: 提出物理模仿学习（PIL）方法，将强化学习（RL）控制策略蒸馏成物理上可实现的身体响应，并将其卸载到并联弹性关节（PEJs），由PEJs模仿部分控制行为，同时由剩余的策略命令电机以恢复RL策略的性能。
results: 在模拟四足机器人上，PIL方法在平坦地形上可将高达87%的机械功率卸载到PEJs，在崎岖地形上可卸载18%，从而实现整体能源消耗的降低。
conclusion: 物理模仿学习（PIL）是一种计算效率高的方法，可以实现脑体协同设计，为基于关节的机器人形态提供任务特定的具身物理智能，而无需扩展搜索空间。

title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models
authors: Mingyang Song, Mao Zheng
abstract: Knowledge distillation has become a primary mechanism for transferring reasoning and domain expertise from frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) to smaller, deployable students. However, the dominant paradigm remains \textit{off-policy}: students train on static teacher-generated data and never encounter their own errors during learning. This train--test mismatch, an instance of \textit{exposure bias}, causes prediction errors to compound autoregressively at inference time. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) addresses this by letting the student generate its own trajectories and receive teacher feedback on these self-generated outputs, grounding distillation in the theory of interactive imitation learning. Despite rapid growth spanning divergence minimization, reward-guided learning, and self-play, the OPD literature remains fragmented with no unified treatment. This survey provides the first comprehensive overview of OPD for LLMs. We introduce a unified $f$-divergence framework over on-policy samples and organize the landscape along three orthogonal dimensions: \emph{feedback signal} (logit-based, outcome-based, or self-play), \emph{teacher access} (white-box, black-box, or teacher-free), and \emph{loss granularity} (token-level, sequence-level, or hybrid). We systematically analyze representative methods, examine industrial deployments, and identify open problems including distillation scaling laws, uncertainty-aware feedback, and agent-level distillation.
zh_title: 大语言模型同策略蒸馏综述
translation: 知识蒸馏已成为将前沿大语言模型（LLM）的推理和领域专业知识迁移到可部署小模型的主要机制。然而，目前的主流范式仍然是“离线”的：学生模型在静态的教师生成数据上进行训练，在学习过程中从未遇到过自己的错误。这种训练与测试的不匹配（即暴露偏差的一种表现）会导致推理时的预测错误出现自回归累积。同策略蒸馏（OPD）通过让学生生成自己的轨迹并对这些自生成输出接收教师反馈，将蒸馏植根于交互式模仿学习理论中，从而解决了上述问题。尽管该领域在散度最小化、奖励引导学习和自博弈方面增长迅速，但OPD文献仍然零散，缺乏统一的论述。本综述提供了首个针对LLM的OPD全面概述。我们引入了一个基于同策略样本的统一f-散度框架，并沿着三个正交维度组织了该领域：反馈信号（基于Logit、基于结果或自博弈）、教师访问方式（白盒、黑盒或无教师）以及损失粒度（Token级、序列级或混合）。我们系统地分析了代表性方法，考察了工业部署情况，并确定了包括蒸馏缩放定律、不确定性感知反馈和智能体级蒸馏在内的开放性问题。
tldr: 本文首次全面综述了大语言模型的同策略蒸馏技术，解决了传统离线蒸馏导致的暴露偏差问题，并提出了统一的理论框架与分类方法。
ai_comments: 本文是首篇针对大语言模型“同策略蒸馏”（On-Policy Distillation）的综合综述，填补了该领域系统性研究的空白。通过引入统一的f-散度框架和三维分类法，极大地提升了该领域研究的清晰度，对于推动高效小模型部署具有重要意义。
motivation: 传统离线蒸馏导致学生模型在训练时无法接触自身预测错误，产生“暴露偏差”，导致推理时误差累积。同策略蒸馏旨在通过让学生模型生成轨迹并获取教师反馈，实现更鲁棒的知识迁移。
method: 作者提出了一个统一的f-散度框架，并从反馈信号（基于Logit、结果或自博弈）、教师访问方式（白盒、黑盒或无教师）以及损失粒度（Token级、序列级或混合）三个维度对现有方法进行了分类和系统分析。
results: 文章梳理了同策略蒸馏的发展现状，分析了工业界部署案例，并指出了蒸馏缩放定律、不确定性感知反馈以及智能体级蒸馏等亟待解决的开放性问题。
conclusion: 同策略蒸馏通过交互式学习有效缓解了传统离线蒸馏中的暴露偏差问题，是提升小模型推理能力的关键路径，未来需进一步研究缩放定律及不确定性反馈机制。

title: Optimal GNSS Time Tracking for Long-term Stable Time Realisation in Synchronised Atomic Clocks
authors: Maitreyee Dutta, Jiayu Chen, Masakazu Koike, Yuichiro Yano, Yuko Hanado, Takayuki Ishizaki
abstract: In this manuscript, we propose a novel optimal Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) time tracking algorithm to collectively steer an ensemble consisting of synchronising miniature atomic clocks towards standard GNSS time. The synchronising miniature atomic clocks generate a common synchronised time which has good short term performance but its accuracy and precision, which is measured by Allan variance, deteriorates in the long run. So, a supervisor designs and periodically broadcasts the proposed GNSS time tracking control to the ensemble miniature atomic clocks that steer the average of ensemble towards the average of GNSS receivers, which are receivers of GNSS time. The tracking control is constructed using a Kalman filter estimation process that estimates the difference in average of GNSS receivers and average of ensemble clocks by using relative clock readings between GNSS receivers and their adjacent ensemble clock. Under the influence of the periodically received tracking control, the stabilised ensemble clocks have better long term accuracy and precision over long averaging periods. Since the tracking control is designed to solely influence the average of the ensemble, the tracking process does not interfere with the synchronisation process and vice versa. The feedback matrix associated with the tracking control is obtained from an optimisation problem that minimises steady-state Allan variance. Numerical results are provided to show the efficacy of the proposed algorithm for enhancing long term performance.

title: When Safe Models Merge into Danger: Exploiting Latent Vulnerabilities in LLM Fusion
authors: Jiaqing Li, Zhibo Zhang, Shide Zhou, Yuxi Li, Tianlong Yu, Kailong Wang
abstract: Model merging has emerged as a powerful technique for combining specialized capabilities from multiple fine-tuned LLMs without additional training costs. However, the security implications of this widely-adopted practice remain critically underexplored. In this work, we reveal that model merging introduces a novel attack surface that can be systematically exploited to compromise safety alignment. We present TrojanMerge,, a framework that embeds latent malicious components into source models that remain individually benign but produce severely misaligned models when merged. Our key insight is formulating this attack as a constrained optimization problem: we construct perturbations that preserve source model safety through directional consistency constraints, maintain capabilities via Frobenius directional alignment constraints, yet combine during merging to form pre-computed attack vectors. Extensive experiments across 9 LLMs from 3 model families demonstrate that TrojanMerge, consistently achieves high harmful response rates in merged models while source models maintain safety scores comparable to unmodified versions. Our attack succeeds across diverse merging algorithms and remains effective under various hyperparameter configurations. These findings expose fundamental vulnerabilities in current model merging practices and highlight the urgent need for security-aware mechanisms.
zh_title: 当安全模型融入危险：利用大型语言模型融合中的潜在漏洞
translation: 模型合并已成为一种强大的技术，可以在没有额外训练成本的情况下，将多个微调LLM的专业能力结合起来。然而，这种广泛采用的做法的安全影响仍然未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们发现模型合并引入了一个新的攻击面，可以系统性地被利用来破坏安全对齐。我们提出了TrojanMerge，一个将潜在恶意组件嵌入源模型的框架，这些源模型本身是良性的，但在合并时会产生严重对齐不良的模型。我们的关键见解是将这种攻击表述为一个约束优化问题：我们构建了通过方向一致性约束来保持源模型安全性的扰动，通过Frobenius方向一致性约束来维持模型能力，但会在合并时结合形成预先计算好的攻击向量。在3个模型家族的9个LLM上进行的广泛实验表明，TrojanMerge在合并模型中持续实现高有害响应率，而源模型保持了与未修改版本相当的安全分数。我们的攻击在各种合并算法中都能成功，并在各种超参数配置下保持有效。这些发现揭示了当前模型合并实践的基本漏洞，并强调了对安全意识机制的迫切需求。
tldr: 模型合并技术可能引入新的安全漏洞，即使原始模型本身是安全的。研究提出了一种名为TrojanMerge的框架，通过在源模型中嵌入潜在的恶意组件，使得合并后的模型产生严重的安全对齐问题，而单个源模型则保持安全。该攻击能够成功地提高合并模型的有害响应率，同时保持源模型的安全分数，并且对多种合并算法和超参数配置都有效，揭示了当前模型合并实践的基本脆弱性。
ai_comments: 这项研究揭示了模型合并技术的一个重要且被忽视的安全漏洞。TrojanMerge框架的创新之处在于它能够在不影响单个模型安全性的前提下，利用模型合并的特性来引入恶意行为，这使得检测和防御变得更加困难。研究结果具有重要的现实意义，因为它直接关系到部署和使用合并模型的安全性。然而，该研究也可能存在局限性，例如攻击的实现复杂度、对特定模型架构或合并算法的依赖性等，这些都需要在未来的工作中进一步探讨。
motivation: 模型合并技术在结合多个微调大型语言模型（LLM）的专业能力方面非常有效，但其安全影响却被严重忽视。本研究旨在揭示模型合并引入的新攻击面，并系统性地利用这些漏洞来破坏安全对齐。
method: 提出了一种名为TrojanMerge的框架，该框架通过构建约束优化问题来嵌入潜在的恶意组件。具体来说，它利用方向一致性约束来保持源模型的安全性，利用Frobenius方向一致性约束来维持模型能力，同时在模型合并时形成预先计算好的攻击向量。
results: TrojanMerge框架在9个不同模型家族的LLM上进行了广泛实验，结果表明，该攻击能够持续地在合并后的模型中实现高比例的有害响应，而源模型本身的安全分数与未修改的版本相当。该攻击对多种合并算法和超参数配置都有效。
conclusion: 模型合并技术存在基本漏洞，可能导致安全对齐被破坏。现有模型合并实践需要引入安全意识机制来应对这些潜在风险，以防止恶意利用。

title: StretchBot: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Adaptive Guidance with Assistive Robots
authors: Luca Vogelgesang, Ahmed Mehdi Soltani, Mohammadhossein Khojasteh, Xinrui Zu, Stefano De Giorgis, Madalina Croitoru, Filip Ilievski
abstract: Assistive robots have growing potential to support physical wellbeing in home and healthcare settings, for example, by guiding users through stretching or rehabilitation routines. However, existing systems remain largely scripted, which limits their ability to adapt to user state, environmental context, and interaction dynamics. In this work, we present StretchBot, a hybrid neuro-symbolic robotic coach for adaptive assistive guidance. The system combines multimodal perception with knowledge-graph-grounded large language model reasoning to support context-aware adjustments during short stretching sessions while maintaining a structured routine. To complement the system description, we report an exploratory pilot comparison between scripted and adaptive guidance with three participants. The pilot findings suggest that the adaptive condition improved perceived adaptability and contextual relevance, while scripted guidance remained competitive in smoothness and predictability. These results provide preliminary evidence that structured actionable knowledge can help ground language-model-based adaptation in embodied assistive interaction, while also highlighting the need for larger, longitudinal studies to evaluate robustness, generalizability, and long-term user experience.
zh_title: StretchBot：一个用于辅助机器人自适应引导的神经符号框架
translation: 辅助机器人（例如，通过引导用户进行拉伸或康复锻炼）在家庭和医疗保健环境中支持身体健康的潜力日益增长。然而，现有系统在很大程度上仍然是脚本化的，这限制了它们适应用户状态、环境背景和交互动态的能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了StretchBot，一个用于自适应辅助引导的混合神经符号机器人教练。该系统结合了多模态感知和以知识图为基础的大型语言模型推理，以支持在短时间拉伸过程中进行上下文感知的调整，同时保持结构化例程。为了补充系统描述，我们报告了一项包含三名参与者的、关于脚本式引导与自适应引导的探索性试点比较。试点研究结果表明，自适应条件提高了感知到的适应性和情境相关性，而脚本式引导在平滑度和可预测性方面仍具竞争力。这些结果提供了初步证据，表明结构化的可操作知识可以帮助将基于语言模型的适应性 grounding 到具身辅助交互中，同时也凸显了需要更大规模、更长期的研究来评估鲁棒性、通用性和长期用户体验。
tldr: StretchBot是一个结合了多模态感知和大型语言模型的混合神经符号系统，可以根据用户状态和环境动态调整辅助机器人（如拉伸指导）的引导方式。初步研究表明，自适应引导比脚本式引导更能提高感知到的适应性和情境相关性，但脚本式引导在平滑度和可预测性方面仍具竞争力。

title: On rankings in multiplayer games with an application to the game of Whist
authors: Alexis Coyette, Charles Modera, Candy Sonveaux, Judicaël Mohet, Francçois-Grégoire Bierwart, Sylverio Pool Marquez, Jarod Ketcha Kouakep, Cédric Simal, Komlan Fiagbe, Violaine Piengeon, Martin Moriamé, Justine Bodart, Marie Dorchain, Maxime Lucas, Rommel Tchinda Djeudjo, Gianluca Peri, Eve Tilman
abstract: We propose a novel extension of the Bradley-Terry model to multiplayer games and adapt a recent algorithm by Newman [1] to our model. We demonstrate the use of our proposed method on synthetic datasets and on a real dataset of games of cards.
comment: Author order determined by the proposed ranking method

title: In the Middle, Not on Top: AI-Mediated Communication for Patient-Provider Care Relationships
authors: Ut Gong, Yibo Meng, Qihan Zhang, Xin Chen, Yan Guan
abstract: Relationship-centered care relies on trust and meaningful connection. As AI enters clinical settings, we must ask not just what it can do, but how it should be positioned to support these values. We examine a "middle, not top" approach where AI mediates communication without usurping human judgment. Through studies of CLEAR, an asynchronous messaging system, we show how this configuration addresses real-world constraints like time pressure and uneven health literacy. We find that mediator affordances (e.g., availability, neutrality) redistribute interpretive work and reduce relational friction. Ultimately, we frame AI mediation as relational infrastructure, highlighting critical design tensions around framing power and privacy.
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, Toward Relationship-Centered Care with AI: Designing for Human Connections in Healthcare workshop at CHI 2026

title: LiPS: Lightweight Panoptic Segmentation for Resource-Constrained Robotics
authors: Calvin Galagain, Martyna Poreba, François Goulette, Cyrill Stachniss
abstract: Panoptic segmentation is a key enabler for robotic perception, as it unifies semantic understanding with object-level reasoning. However, the increasing complexity of state-of-the-art models makes them unsuitable for deployment on resource-constrained platforms such as mobile robots. We propose a novel approach called LiPS that addresses the challenge of efficient-to-compute panoptic segmentation with a lightweight design that retains query-based decoding while introducing a streamlined feature extraction and fusion pathway. It aims at providing a strong panoptic segmentation performance while substantially lowering the computational demands. Evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that LiPS attains accuracy comparable to much heavier baselines, while providing up to 4.5 higher throughput, measured in frames per second, and requiring nearly 6.8 times fewer computations. This efficiency makes LiPS a highly relevant bridge between modern panoptic models and real-world robotic applications.
comment: Submitted to IEEE ICIP 2026. Under review

title: On Minimum Distances for Error Correction and Detection of Generalized Network Code
authors: Yulin Chen, Raymond W. Yeung
abstract: It is well known that the minimum distance for linear network codes plays the same role as the minimum distance for classical error control codes. However, Yang and Yeung (2008) discovered that for nonlinear network codes, the minimum distance for error correction is not always the same as the minimum distance for error detection. Inspired by the idea that the channel will affect the distances between the codewords, we establish the scheme of a generalized network channel and a generalized network code. Then, we systematically define the distances for error correction and error detection under the scheme of the generalized network code. We consider the joint error correction and detection in the generalized network code and obtain a complete characterization by introducing a distance and its refined version for this purpose. We enhance our understanding of the relation between various distances for error correction and detection in generalized network codes by proving some bounds on these distances.

title: DirectFisheye-GS: Enabling Native Fisheye Input in Gaussian Splatting with Cross-View Joint Optimization
authors: Zhengxian Yang, Fei Xie, Xutao Xue, Rui Zhang, Taicheng Huang, Yang Liu, Mengqi Ji, Tao Yu
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled efficient 3D scene reconstruction from everyday images with real-time, high-fidelity rendering, greatly advancing VR/AR applications. Fisheye cameras, with their wider field of view (FOV), promise high-quality reconstructions from fewer inputs and have recently attracted much attention. However, since 3DGS relies on rasterization, most subsequent works involving fisheye camera inputs first undistort images before training, which introduces two problems: 1) Black borders at image edges cause information loss and negate the fisheye's large FOV advantage; 2) Undistortion's stretch-and-interpolate resampling spreads each pixel's value over a larger area, diluting detail density -- causes 3DGS overfitting these low-frequency zones, producing blur and floating artifacts. In this work, we integrate fisheye camera model into the original 3DGS framework, enabling native fisheye image input for training without preprocessing. Despite correct modeling, we observed that the reconstructed scenes still exhibit floaters at image edges: Distortion increases toward the periphery, and 3DGS's original per-iteration random-selecting-view optimization ignores the cross-view correlations of a Gaussian, leading to extreme shapes (e.g., oversized or elongated) that degrade reconstruction quality. To address this, we introduce a feature-overlap-driven cross-view joint optimization strategy that establishes consistent geometric and photometric constraints across views-a technique equally applicable to existing pinhole-camera-based pipelines. Our DirectFisheye-GS matches or surpasses state-of-the-art performance on public datasets.

title: When AI and Experts Agree on Error: Intrinsic Ambiguity in Dermatoscopic Images
authors: Loris Cino, Pier Luigi Mazzeo, Alessandro Martella, Giulia Radi, Renato Rossi, Cosimo Distante
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), into dermatological diagnosis demonstrates substantial clinical potential. While existing literature predominantly benchmarks algorithmic performance against human experts, our study adopts a novel perspective by investigating the intrinsic complexity of dermatoscopic images. Through rigorous experimentation with multiple CNN architectures, we isolated a subset of images systematically misclassified across all models-a phenomenon statistically proven to exceed random chance. To determine if these failures stem from algorithmic biases or inherent visual ambiguity, expert dermatologists independently evaluated these challenging cases alongside a control group. The results revealed a collapse in human diagnostic performance on the AI-misclassified images. First, agreement with ground-truth labels plummeted, with Cohen's kappa dropping to a mere 0.08 for the difficult images, compared to a 0.61 for the control group. Second, we observed a severe deterioration in expert consensus; inter-rater reliability among physicians fell from moderate concordance (Fleiss kappa = 0.456) on control images to only modest agreement (Fleiss kappa = 0.275) on difficult cases. We identified image quality as a primary driver of these dual systematic failures. To promote transparency and reproducibility, all data, code, and trained models have been made publicly available

title: LibScan: Smart Contract Library Misuse Detection with Iterative Feedback and Static Verification
authors: Yishun Wang, Wenkai Li, Xiaoqi Li, Zongwei Li, Lei Xie, Yuqing Zhang
abstract: Smart contracts are self-executing programs that manage financial transactions on blockchain networks. Developers commonly rely on third-party code libraries to improve both efficiency and security. However, improper use of these libraries can introduce hidden vulnerabilities that are difficult to detect, leading to significant financial losses. Existing automated tools struggle to identify such misuse because it often requires understanding the developer's intent rather than simply scanning for known code patterns. This paper presents LibScan, an automated detection framework that combines large language model (LLM)-based semantic reasoning with rule-based code analysis, identifying eight distinct categories of library misuse in smart contracts. To improve detection reliability, the framework incorporates an iterative self-correction mechanism that refines its analysis across multiple rounds, alongside a structured knowledge base derived from large-scale empirical studies of real-world misuse cases. Experiments conducted on 662 real-world smart contracts demonstrate that LibScan achieves an overall detection accuracy of 85.15\%, outperforming existing tools by a margin of over 16 percentage points. Ablation experiments further confirm that combining both analysis approaches yields substantially better results than either method used independently.

title: Battery Electric Truck Infrastructure Co-design via Joint Optimization and Agent-based Simulation
authors: Juan Pablo Bertucci, Mauro Salazar, Theo Hofman
abstract: As zero-emission zones emerge in European cities, fleet operators are shifting to electric vehicles. To maintain their current operations, a clear understanding of the charging infrastructure required and its relationship to existing power grid limitations is needed. This study presents an optimization frame-work for jointly designing charging infrastructure and schedules within a logistics distribution network, validated through agent-based simulations. We formulate the problem as a mixed-integer linear program and develop an agent-based model to evaluate various designs and operations under stochastic conditions. Our experiments compare rule-based and optimized strategies in a case study of the Netherlands. Results show that current commercial solutions suffice for middle-mile logistics, with central co-design yielding average cost reductions of 5.2% to 6.4% and an average 20.1% decrease in total installed power. While rule-based control effectively manages charging operations and mitigates delays, optimizing charge scheduling significantly reduces queuing times (99%), charging costs (13.5%), and time spent near capacity (10.9%). Our optimization-simulation framework paves the way for combining optimized infrastructure planning and realistic fleet operations in digital-twin environments.

title: Chameleons do not Forget: Prompt-Based Online Continual Learning for Next Activity Prediction
authors: Marwan Hassani, Tamara Verbeek, Sjoerd van Straten
abstract: Predictive process monitoring (PPM) focuses on predicting future process trajectories, including next activity predictions. This is crucial in dynamic environments where processes change or face uncertainty. However, current frameworks often assume a static environment, overlooking dynamic characteristics and concept drifts. This results in catastrophic forgetting, where training while focusing merely on new data distribution negatively impacts the performance on previously learned data distributions. Continual learning addresses, among others, the challenges related to mitigating catastrophic forgetting. This paper proposes a novel approach called Continual Next Activity Prediction with Prompts (CNAPwP), which adapts the DualPrompt algorithm for next activity prediction to improve accuracy and adaptability while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. We introduce new datasets with recurring concept drifts, alongside a task-specific forgetting metric that measures the prediction accuracy gap between initial occurrence and subsequent task occurrences. Extensive testing on three synthetic and two real-world datasets representing several setups of recurrent drifts shows that CNAPwP achieves SOTA or competitive results compared to five baselines, demonstrating its potential applicability in real-world scenarios. An open-source implementation of our method, together with the datasets and results, is available at: https://github.com/SvStraten/CNAPwP.
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in the International Journal of Cooperative Information Systems

title: Explicit MPC for Parameter Dependent Linear Systems
authors: Carlos J. G. Rojas, Esteban Lage Cano, Leyla Özkan
abstract: This paper presents two explicit Model Predictive Control formulations for linear systems parameterized in terms of design variables. Such parameter dependent behavior commonly arises from operating point dependent linearization of nonlinear systems as well as from variations in mechanical, electrical, or thermal properties associated with material selection in the design of the process or system components. In contrast to explicit MPC approaches that treat design parameter variations and dependencies as disturbances, the proposed methods incorporate the parameters directly into the system matrices in an affine manner. However, explicitly incorporating these dependencies significantly increases the complexity of explicit MPC formulations due to resulting nonlinear terms involving decision variables and parameters. We address this complexity by proposing two approximation methods. Both methods are applied to two examples, and their performances are compared with respect to the exact eMPC implementation.

title: Streaming Model Cascades for Semantic SQL
authors: Paweł Liskowski, Kyle Schmaus
abstract: Modern data warehouses extend SQL with semantic operators that invoke large language models on each qualifying row, but the per-row inference cost is prohibitive at scale. Model cascades reduce this cost by routing most rows through a fast proxy model and delegating uncertain cases to an expensive oracle. Existing frameworks, however, require global dataset access and optimize a single quality metric, limiting their applicability in distributed systems where data is partitioned across independent workers. We present two adaptive cascade algorithms designed for streaming, per-partition execution in which each worker processes its partition independently without inter-worker communication. SUPG-IT extends the SUPG statistical framework to streaming execution with iterative threshold refinement and joint precision-recall guarantees. GAMCAL replaces user-specified quality targets with a learned calibration model: a Generalized Additive Model maps proxy scores to calibrated probabilities with uncertainty quantification, enabling direct optimization of a cost-quality tradeoff through a single parameter. Experiments on six datasets in a production semantic SQL engine show that both algorithms achieve F1 > 0.95 on every dataset. GAMCAL achieves higher F1 per oracle call at cost-sensitive operating points, while SUPG-IT reaches a higher quality ceiling with formal guarantees on precision and recall.

title: TRIMS: Trajectory-Ranked Instruction Masked Supervision for Diffusion Language Models
authors: Lingjie Chen, Ruizhong Qiu, Yuyu Fan, Yanjun Zhao, Hanghang Tong
abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a promising path toward low-latency generation through parallel decoding, but their practical efficiency depends heavily on the decoding trajectory. In practice, this advantage often fails to fully materialize because standard training does not provide explicit supervision over token reveal order, creating a train-inference mismatch that leads to suboptimal decoding behavior. We propose Trajectory-Ranked Instruction Masked Supervision (TRIMS), a simple trajectory-guided supervised fine-tuning framework that injects trajectory supervision into standard Masked Diffusion Language Model (MDLM) training with minimal overhead. Instead of relying on costly DLM-based distillation, TRIMS uses lightweight signals from an autoregressive teacher to guide a trajectory-aware masking strategy, encouraging the model to learn more effective decoding orders. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream across math and coding benchmarks show that TRIMS significantly improves the accuracy-parallelism trade-off over both standard MDLM training and train-free acceleration baselines, while achieving competitive performance with prior distillation-based approaches at substantially lower training cost. Further analysis shows that TRIMS leads to better decoding trajectories, validating the effectiveness of trajectory-guided supervision for DLMs.

title: Common TF-IDF variants arise as key components in the test statistic of a penalized likelihood-ratio test for word burstiness
authors: Zeyad Ahmed, Paul Sheridan, Michael McIsaac, Aitazaz A. Farooque
abstract: TF-IDF is a classical formula that is widely used for identifying important terms within documents. We show that TF-IDF-like scores arise naturally from the test statistic of a penalized likelihood-ratio test setup capturing word burstiness (also known as word over-dispersion). In our framework, the alternative hypothesis captures word burstiness by modeling a collection of documents according to a family of beta-binomial distributions with a gamma penalty term on the precision parameter. In contrast, the null hypothesis assumes that words are binomially distributed in collection documents, a modeling approach that fails to account for word burstiness. We find that a term-weighting scheme given rise to by this test statistic performs comparably to TF-IDF on document classification tasks. This paper provides insights into TF-IDF from a statistical perspective and underscores the potential of hypothesis testing frameworks for advancing term-weighting scheme development.
comment: 27 pages, 3 tables, 7 figures, accepted in Discover Computing 2026

title: Embedded Variational Neural Stochastic Differential Equations for Learning Heterogeneous Dynamics
authors: Sandeep Kumar Samota, Reema Gupta, Snehashish Chakraverty
abstract: This study examines the challenges of modeling complex and noisy data related to socioeconomic factors over time, with a focus on data from various districts in Odisha, India. Traditional time-series models struggle to capture both trends and variations together in this type of data. To tackle this, a Variational Neural Stochastic Differential Equation (V-NSDE) model is designed that combines the expressive dynamics of Neural SDEs with the generative capabilities of Variational Autoencoders (VAEs). This model uses an encoder and a decoder. The encoder takes the initial observations and district embeddings and translates them into a Gaussian distribution, which determines the mean and log-variance of the first latent state. Then the obtained latent state initiates the Neural SDE, which utilize neural networks to determine the drift and diffusion functions that govern continuous-time latent dynamics. These governing functions depend on the time index, latent state, and district embedding, which help the model learn the unique characteristics specific to each district. After that, using a probabilistic decoder, the observations are reconstructed from the latent trajectory. The decoder outputs a mean and log-variance for each time step, which follows the Gaussian likelihood. The Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) training loss improves by adding a KL-divergence regularization term to the negative log-likelihood (nll). The obtained results demonstrate the effective learning of V-NSDE in recognizing complex patterns over time, yielding realistic outcomes that include clear trends and random fluctuations across different areas.

title: Analytical Probabilistic Power Flow Approximation Using Invertible Neural Networks
authors: Weijie Xia, James Ciyu Qin, Edgar Mauricio Salazar Duque, Hongjin Du, Peter Palensky, Giovanni Sansavini, Pedro P. Vergara
abstract: Probabilistic power flow (PPF) is essential for quantifying operational uncertainty in modern distribution systems with high penetration of renewable generation and flexible loads. Conventional PPF methods primarily rely on Monte Carlo (MC) based power flow (PF) simulations or simplified analytical approximations. While MC approaches are computationally intensive and demand substantial data storage, analytical approximations often compromise accuracy. In this paper, we propose a novel analytical PPF framework that eliminates the dependence on MC-based PF simulations and, in principle, enables an approximation of the analytical form of arbitrary voltage distributions. The core idea is to learn an explicit and invertible mapping between stochastic power injections and system voltages using invertible neural networks (INNs). By leveraging the Change of Variable Theorem, the proposed framework facilitates direct approximation of the analytical form of voltage probability distributions without repeated PF computations. Extensive numerical studies demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art performance both as a high-accuracy PF solver and as an efficient analytical PPF estimator.

title: CL-VISTA: Benchmarking Continual Learning in Video Large Language Models
authors: Haiyang Guo, Yichen Shi, Fei Zhu, Wenzhuo Liu, Hongbo Zhao, Fanhu Zeng, Shijie Ma, Da-Han Wang, Xu-Yao Zhang
abstract: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) require continual learning to adapt to non-stationary real-world data. However, existing benchmarks fall short of evaluating modern foundation models: many still rely on models without large-scale pre-training, and prevailing benchmarks typically partition a single dataset into sub-tasks, resulting in high task redundancy and negligible forgetting on pre-trained Video-LLMs. To address these limitations, we propose CL-VISTA, a benchmark tailored for continual video understanding of Video-LLMs. By curating 8 diverse tasks spanning perception, understanding, and reasoning, CL-VISTA induces substantial distribution shifts that effectively expose catastrophic forgetting. To systematically assess CL methods, we establish a comprehensive evaluation framework comprising 6 distinct protocols across 3 critical dimensions: performance, computational efficiency, and memory footprint. Notably, the performance dimension incorporates a general video understanding assessment to assess whether CL methods genuinely enhance foundational intelligence or merely induce task-specific overfitting. Extensive benchmarking of 10 mainstream CL methods reveals a fundamental trade-off: no single approach achieves universal superiority across all dimensions. Methods that successfully mitigate catastrophic forgetting tend to compromise generalization or incur prohibitive computational and memory overheads. We hope CL-VISTA provides critical insights for advancing continual learning in multimodal foundation models.

title: MoonAnything: A Vision Benchmark with Large-Scale Lunar Supervised Data
authors: Clémentine Grethen, Yuang Shi, Simone Gasparini, Géraldine Morin
abstract: Accurate perception of lunar surfaces is critical for modern lunar exploration missions.
