As part of the Optimus library, we also developed a robust set of reliability and fault tolerant features to improve training stability and continuity at scale.

title: The Rise of Language Models in Mining Software Repositories: A Survey
authors: Miguel Romero-Arjona, Saman Barakat, Ana B. Sánchez, Sergio Segura
abstract: The Mining Software Repositories (MSR) field focuses on analysing the rich data contained in software repositories to derive actionable insights into software processes and products. Mining repositories at scale requires techniques capable of handling large volumes of heterogeneous data, a challenge for which language models (LMs) are increasingly well-suited. Since the advent of Transformer-based architectures, LMs have been rapidly adopted across a wide range of MSR tasks. This article presents a comprehensive survey of the use of LMs in MSR, based on an analysis of 85 papers. We examine how LMs are applied, the types of artefacts analysed, which models are used, how their adoption has evolved over time, and the extent to which studies support reproducibility and reuse. Building on this analysis, we propose a taxonomy of LM applications in MSR, identify key trends shaping the field, and highlight open challenges alongside actionable directions for future research.

title: Valency Classification of Mapudungun Verbal Roots. Established by the language's own morphotactics
authors: Andrés Chandía
abstract: In the previous work, a lexical (re)categorisation -- or confirmation of the given category -- of roots identified as verbal was undertaken to determine their original category accurately. Building on this, the present paper offers an account of the valency classification of those Mapudungun roots confirmed to be verbal, using the language's own morphotactics; specifically, by examining the permissible and restricted combinations of various suffixes with roots or verbal stems in the Mapuche verb form. As with all work conducted thus far, the results presented here aim to improve the morphological analyser (Dungupeyum) with all verified findings incorporated into the system. From a theoretical perspective, we also hope to contribute to the recognition and understanding of issues related to the valency of Mapuche verb forms.

title: UK AISI Alignment Evaluation Case-Study
authors: Alexandra Souly, Robert Kirk, Jacob Merizian, Abby D'Cruz, Xander Davies
abstract: This technical report presents methods developed by the UK AI Security Institute for assessing whether advanced AI systems reliably follow intended goals. Specifically, we evaluate whether frontier models sabotage safety research when deployed as coding assistants within an AI lab. Applying our methods to four frontier models, we find no confirmed instances of research sabotage. However, we observe that Claude Opus 4.5 Preview (a pre-release snapshot of Opus 4.5) and Sonnet 4.5 frequently refuse to engage with safety-relevant research tasks, citing concerns about research direction, involvement in self-training, and research scope. We additionally find that Opus 4.5 Preview shows reduced unprompted evaluation awareness compared to Sonnet 4.5, while both models can distinguish evaluation from deployment scenarios when prompted. Our evaluation framework builds on Petri, an open-source LLM auditing tool, with a custom scaffold designed to simulate realistic internal deployment of a coding agent. We validate that this scaffold produces trajectories that all tested models fail to reliably distinguish from real deployment data. We test models across scenarios varying in research motivation, activity type, replacement threat, and model autonomy. Finally, we discuss limitations including scenario coverage and evaluation awareness.

title: Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation for Accessible Route Planning
authors: Paolo Speziali, Arno De Greef, Mehrdad Asadi, Willem Röpke, Ann Nowé, Diederik M. Roijers
abstract: We propose the Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation (PG-IPRO) for urban route planning for people with different accessibility requirements and preferences. With this algorithm the user can interact with the system by giving feedback on a route, i.e., the user can say which objective should be further minimized, or conversely can be relaxed. This leads to intuitive user interaction, that is especially effective during early iterations compared to information-gain-based interaction. Furthermore, due to PG-IPRO's iterative nature, the full set of alternative, possibly optimal policies (the Pareto front), is never computed, leading to higher computational efficiency and shorter waiting times for users.

title: HICT: High-precision 3D CBCT reconstruction from a single X-ray
authors: Wen Ma, Jiaxiang Liu, Zikai Xiao, Ziyang Wang, Feng Yang, Zuozhu Liu
abstract: Accurate 3D dental imaging is vital for diagnosis and treatment planning, yet CBCT's high radiation dose and cost limit its accessibility. Reconstructing 3D volumes from a single low-dose panoramic X-ray is a promising alternative but remains challenging due to geometric inconsistencies and limited accuracy. We propose HiCT, a two-stage framework that first generates geometrically consistent multi-view projections from a single panoramic image using a video diffusion model, and then reconstructs high-fidelity CBCT from the projections using a ray-based dynamic attention network and an X-ray sampling strategy. To support this, we built XCT, a large-scale dataset combining public CBCT data with 500 paired PX-CBCT cases. Extensive experiments show that HiCT achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering accurate and geometrically consistent reconstructions for clinical use.

title: Approximation Algorithms for Budget Splitting in Multi-Channel Influence Maximization
authors: Dildar Ali, Ansh Jasrotia, Abishek Salaria, Suman Banerjee
abstract: How to utilize an allocated budget effectively for branding and promotion of a commercial house is an important problem, particularly when multiple advertising media are available. There exist multiple such media, and among them, two popular ones are billboards and social media advertisements. In this context, the question naturally arises: how should a budget be allocated to maximize total influence? Although there is significant literature on the effective use of budgets in individual advertising media, there are hardly any studies examining budget allocation across multiple advertising media. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces the \textsc{Budget Splitting Problem in Billboard and Social Network Advertisement}. We introduce the notion of \emph{interaction effect} to capture the additional influence due to triggers from multiple media of advertising. Using this notion, we propose a noble influence function $Φ(,)$ that captures the total influence and shows that this function is non-negative, monotone, and non-bisubmodular. We introduce \emph{bi-submodularity ratio $(γ)$} and \emph{generalized curvature $(α)$} to measure how close a function is to being bi-submodular and how far a function is from being modular, respectively. We propose the Randomized Greedy and Two-Phase Adaptive Greedy approach, where the influence function is non-bisubmodular and achieves an approximation guarantee of $\frac{1}α\left(1-e^ {-γα} \right)$. We conducted several experiments using real-world datasets and observed that the proposed solution approach's budget splitting leads to a greater influence than existing approaches.
comment: This paper has been accepted in the 24th Symposium on Experimental Algorithms (SEA 2026)

title: RefineRL: Advancing Competitive Programming with Self-Refinement Reinforcement Learning
authors: Shaopeng Fu, Xingxing Zhang, Li Dong, Di Wang, Furu Wei
abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on complex reasoning tasks such as competitive programming (CP), existing methods predominantly focus on single-attempt settings, overlooking their capacity for iterative refinement. In this paper, we present RefineRL, a novel approach designed to unleash the self-refinement capabilities of LLMs for CP problem solving. RefineRL introduces two key innovations: (1) Skeptical-Agent, an iterative self-refinement agent equipped with local execution tools to validate generated solutions against public test cases of CP problems. This agent always maintains a skeptical attitude towards its own outputs and thereby enforces rigorous self-refinement even when validation suggests correctness. (2) A reinforcement learning (RL) solution to incentivize LLMs to self-refine with only standard RLVR data (i.e., problems paired with their verifiable answers). Extensive experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-4B-2507 demonstrate that our method yields substantial gains: after our RL training, these compact 4B models integrated with the Skeptical-Agent not only outperform much larger 32B models but also approach the single-attempt performance of 235B models. These findings suggest that self-refinement holds considerable promise for scaling LLM reasoning, with significant potential for further advancement.

title: Multimodal Language Models Cannot Spot Spatial Inconsistencies
authors: Om Khangaonkar, Hadi J. Rad, Hamed Pirsiavash
abstract: Spatial consistency is a fundamental property of the visual world and a key requirement for models that aim to understand physical reality. Despite recent advances, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to reason about 3D geometry across multiple views. Rather than asking models to describe scene attributes, we introduce a more challenging task: given two views of the same scene, identify the object that violates 3D motion consistency. We propose a simple and scalable method for generating realistic, spatially inconsistent image pairs from multi-view scenes, enabling systematic evaluation of this capability. Our results show that state-of-the-art MLLMs significantly underperform human observers and exhibit substantial variability across different scene attributes, revealing a fragile and incomplete understanding of 3D structure. We hope our findings underscore the need for approaches that develop a more deeply grounded understanding of the physical world.

title: Routing-Free Mixture-of-Experts
authors: Yilun Liu, Jinru Han, Sikuan Yan, Volker Tresp, Yunpu Ma
abstract: Standard Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models rely on centralized routing mechanisms that introduce rigid inductive biases. We propose Routing-Free MoE which eliminates any hard-coded centralized designs including external routers, Softmax, Top-K and load balancing, instead encapsulating all activation functionalities within individual experts and directly optimized through continuous gradient flow, enabling each expert to determine its activation entirely on its own. We introduce a unified adaptive load-balancing framework to simultaneously optimize both expert-balancing and token-balancing objectives through a configurable interpolation, allowing flexible and customizable resource allocation. Extensive experiments show that Routing-Free MoE can consistently outperform baselines with better scalability and robustness. We analyze its behavior in detail and offer insights that may facilitate future MoE design ad optimization.

title: MIRANDA: MId-feature RANk-adversarial Domain Adaptation toward climate change-robust ecological forecasting with deep learning
authors: Yuchang Jiang, Jan Dirk Wegner, Vivien Sainte Fare Garnot
abstract: Plant phenology modelling aims to predict the timing of seasonal phases, such as leaf-out or flowering, from meteorological time series. Reliable predictions are crucial for anticipating ecosystem responses to climate change. While phenology modelling has traditionally relied on mechanistic approaches, deep learning methods have recently been proposed as flexible, data-driven alternatives with often superior performance. However, mechanistic models tend to outperform deep networks when data distribution shifts are induced by climate change. Domain Adaptation (DA) techniques could help address this limitation. Yet, unlike standard DA settings, climate change induces a temporal continuum of domains and involves both a covariate and label shift, with warmer records and earlier start of spring. To tackle this challenge, we introduce Mid-feature Rank-adversarial Domain Adaptation (MIRANDA). Whereas conventional adversarial methods enforce domain invariance on final latent representations, an approach that does not explicitly address label shift, we apply adversarial regularization to intermediate features. Moreover, instead of a binary domain-classification objective, we employ a rank-based objective that enforces year-invariance in the learned meteorological representations. On a country-scale dataset spanning 70 years and comprising 67,800 phenological observations of 5 tree species, we demonstrate that, unlike conventional DA approaches, MIRANDA improves robustness to climatic distribution shifts and narrows the performance gap with mechanistic models.

title: A novel three-step approach to forecast firm-specific technology convergence opportunity via multi-dimensional feature fusion
authors: Fu Gu, Ao Chen, Yingwen Wu
abstract: As a crucial innovation paradigm, technology convergence (TC) is gaining ever-increasing attention. Yet, existing studies primarily focus on predicting TC at the industry level, with little attention paid to TC forecast for firm-specific technology opportunity discovery (TOD). Moreover, although technological documents like patents contain a rich body of bibliometric, network structure, and textual features, such features are underexploited in the extant TC predictions; most of the relevant studies only used one or two dimensions of these features, and all the three dimensional features have rarely been fused. Here we propose a novel approach that fuses multi-dimensional features from patents to predict TC for firm-specific TOD. Our method comprises three steps, which are elaborated as follows. First, bibliometric, network structure, and textual features are extracted from patent documents, and then fused at the International Patent Classification (IPC)-pair level using attention mechanisms. Second, IPC-level TC opportunities are identified using a two-stage ensemble learning model that incorporates various imbalance-handling strategies. Third, to acquire feasible firm-specific TC opportunities, the performance metrics of topic-level TC opportunities, which are refined from IPC-level opportunities, are evaluated via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a large language model (LLM). We prove the effectiveness of our proposed approach by predicting TC opportunities for a leading Chinese auto part manufacturer, Zhejiang Sanhua Intelligent Controls co., ltd, in the domains of thermal management for energy storage and robotics. In sum, this work advances the theory and applicability of forecasting firm-specific TC opportunity through fusing multi-dimensional features and leveraging LLM-as-a-judge for technology opportunity evaluation.

title: Compact Keyframe-Optimized Multi-Agent Gaussian Splatting SLAM
authors: Monica M.Q. Li, Pierre-Yves Lajoie, Jialiang Liu, Giovanni Beltrame
abstract: Efficient multi-agent 3D mapping is essential for robotic teams operating in unknown environments, but dense representations hinder real-time exchange over constrained communication links. In multi-agent Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), systems typically rely on a centralized server to merge and optimize the local maps produced by individual agents. However, sharing these large map representations, particularly those generated by recent methods such as Gaussian Splatting, becomes a bottleneck in real-world scenarios with limited bandwidth. We present an improved multi-agent RGB-D Gaussian Splatting SLAM framework that reduces communication load while preserving map fidelity. First, we incorporate a compaction step into our SLAM system to remove redundant 3D Gaussians, without degrading the rendering quality. Second, our approach performs centralized loop closure computation without initial guess, operating in two modes: a pure rendered-depth mode that requires no data beyond the 3D Gaussians, and a camera-depth mode that includes lightweight depth images for improved registration accuracy and additional Gaussian pruning. Evaluation on both synthetic and real-world datasets shows up to 85-95\% reduction in transmitted data compared to state-of-the-art approaches in both modes, bringing 3D Gaussian multi-agent SLAM closer to practical deployment in real-world scenarios. Code: https://github.com/lemonci/coko-slam
zh_title: 紧凑关键帧优化的多智能体高斯泼溅SLAM
translation: 高效的多智能体3D建图对于在未知环境中运行的机器人团队至关重要，但密集的表示会阻碍在受限通信链路上进行实时交换。在多智能体同时定位与建图（SLAM）中，系统通常依赖于中央服务器来合并和优化单个智能体生成的局部地图。然而，共享这些大型地图表示，特别是那些由高斯泼溅等最新方法生成的表示，在带宽有限的真实世界场景中成为瓶颈。我们提出了一种改进的多智能体RGB-D高斯泼溅SLAM框架，该框架在保持地图保真度的同时减少了通信负载。首先，我们将一个压缩步骤整合到我们的SLAM系统中，以移除冗余的3D高斯，而不会降低渲染质量。其次，我们的方法执行无需初始猜测的集中式回环检测计算，以两种模式运行：纯渲染深度模式，除了3D高斯之外不需要任何数据；以及相机深度模式，包含轻量级深度图像以提高配准精度和额外的高斯修剪。在合成和真实世界数据集上的评估显示，与现有最先进方法相比，两种模式下的传输数据量减少了85-95%，使3D高斯多智能体SLAM更接近在真实世界场景中的实际部署。代码：https://github.com/lemonci/coko-slam

ai_comments: 本文通过在高斯泼溅SLAM中引入创新的数据压缩和双模式回环检测机制，有效解决了多智能体系统在有限通信带宽下的实时数据交换瓶颈。这种方法在保持地图质量的同时显著减少了数据传输量，对于提高多机器人系统在复杂未知环境中的协作效率和实际部署能力具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的多智能体3D建图方法（尤其是基于高斯泼溅的密集表示）在有限带宽的通信链路上会产生巨大的数据传输量，从而阻碍实时数据交换，形成通信瓶颈。
method: 本文提出了一种改进的多智能体RGB-D高斯泼溅SLAM框架。首先，通过引入一个压缩步骤来移除冗余的3D高斯，同时不降低渲染质量。其次，执行无需初始猜测的集中式回环检测，该过程有两种模式：纯渲染深度模式（仅需3D高斯数据）和相机深度模式（包含轻量级深度图像以提高配准精度和额外高斯修剪）。

title: Revisiting Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval with Pre-Trained Vision Transformers
authors: Kawtar Zaher, Olivier Buisson, Alexis Joly
abstract: Building on existing approaches, we revisit Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval, a task that consists of iteratively retrieving images containing objects of a class-of-interest, specified by a user-provided query. Starting from a large unlabeled image collection, the aim is to rapidly identify diverse instances of an object category relying solely on the initial query and the user's Relevance Feedback, with no prior labels. The retrieval process is formulated as a binary classification task, where the system continuously learns to distinguish between relevant and non-relevant images to the query, through iterative user interaction. This interaction is guided by an Active Learning loop: at each iteration, the system selects informative samples for user annotation, thereby refining the retrieval performance. This task is particularly challenging in multi-object datasets, where the object of interest may occupy only a small region of the image within a complex, cluttered scene. Unlike object-centered settings where global descriptors often suffice, multi-object images require more adapted, localized descriptors. In this work, we formulate and revisit the Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval task by leveraging pre-trained ViT representations, and addressing key design questions, including which object instances to consider in an image, what form the annotations should take, how Active Selection should be applied, and which representation strategies best capture the object's features. We compare several representation strategies across multi-object datasets highlighting trade-offs between capturing the global context and focusing on fine-grained local object details. Our results offer practical insights for the design of effective interactive retrieval pipelines based on Active Learning for object class retrieval.
zh_title: 基于预训练视觉Transformer重新审视人机协同对象检索
translation: 基于现有方法，我们重新审视了人机协同对象检索（Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval），这是一项由用户查询指定感兴趣类别，并迭代检索包含该对象图像的任务。从大规模无标签图像集合出发，目标是在没有先验标签的情况下，仅依赖初始查询和用户的相关性反馈，快速识别出该对象类别的不同实例。检索过程被建模为二分类任务，系统通过迭代用户交互持续学习区分与查询相关和不相关的图像。这种交互由主动学习循环引导：在每次迭代中，系统选择信息量大的样本供用户标注，从而优化检索性能。在多对象数据集中，该任务极具挑战性，因为目标对象可能仅占据复杂杂乱场景中图像的一小部分。与全局描述符通常足够的以对象为中心的设置不同，多对象图像需要更适应的局部描述符。在这项工作中，我们通过利用预训练ViT表征并解决关键设计问题（包括图像中应考虑哪些对象实例、标注应采取何种形式、应如何应用主动选择，以及哪些表征策略最能捕捉对象的特征）来重新审视人机协同对象检索任务。我们比较了跨多对象数据集的几种表征策略，强调了捕捉全局上下文与聚焦细粒度局部对象细节之间的权衡。我们的结果为设计基于主动学习的有效交互式对象类检索流程提供了实践洞察。
tldr: 本文利用预训练ViT改进了人机协同对象检索，通过主动学习和精细的局部特征表征，有效解决了复杂场景下目标对象识别的难题。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入预训练Vision Transformers（ViT）重新审视了人机协同（HITL）对象检索，解决了复杂场景下多对象检索的挑战。其创新在于系统地探讨了表征策略、主动学习选择机制及标注形式，为构建高效的交互式检索流程提供了实用的设计指南。
motivation: 现有方法在处理多对象、复杂背景场景时，全局描述符表现不足，需要更精细、局部化的描述符来提升检索准确性。
method: 利用预训练的ViT提取图像特征，将检索过程建模为二分类任务，并结合主动学习（Active Learning）循环进行迭代，通过对比不同表征策略（全局与局部）来优化检索性能。
results: 研究结果明确了全局上下文与细粒度局部细节在特征表征中的权衡，并验证了基于ViT的表征策略在多对象数据集上的有效性。
conclusion: 通过对比不同表征策略，本文为设计高效的交互式对象检索系统提供了明确的设计准则和实践洞察，证明了ViT在处理复杂多对象场景下的有效性。

title: Role Differentiation in a Coupled Resource Ecology under Multi-Level Selection
authors: Siddharth Chaturvedi, Ahmed El-Gazzar, Marcel van Gerven
abstract: A group of non-cooperating agents can succumb to the \emph{tragedy-of-the-commons} if all of them seek to maximize the same resource channel to improve their viability. In nature, however, groups often avoid such collapses by differentiating into distinct roles that exploit different resource channels. It remains unclear how such coordination can emerge under continual individual-level selection alone. To address this, we introduce a computational model of multi-level selection, in which group-level selection shapes a common substrate and mutation operator shared by all group members undergoing individual-level selection. We also place this process in an embodied ecology where distinct resource channels are not segregated, but coupled through the same behavioral primitives. These channels are classified as a positive-sum intake channel and a zero-sum redistribution channel. We investigate whether such a setting can give rise to role differentiation under turnover driven by birth and death. We find that in a learned ecology, both channels remain occupied at the colony level, and the collapse into a single acquisition mode is avoided. Zero-sum channel usage increases over generations despite not being directly optimized by group-level selection. Channel occupancy also fluctuates over the lifetime of a boid. Ablation studies suggest that most baseline performance is carried by the inherited behavioral basis, while the learned variation process provides a smaller but systematic improvement prior to saturation. Together, the results suggest that multi-level selection can enable groups in a common-pool setting to circumvent tragedy-of-the-commons through differentiated use of coupled channels under continual turnover.
zh_title: 多层次选择下耦合资源生态中的角色分化
translation: 一群非合作的代理如果都试图最大化相同的资源渠道以提高其生存能力，就可能陷入“公地悲剧”。然而，在自然界中，群体通常通过分化为利用不同资源渠道的独特角色来避免此类崩溃。目前尚不清楚这种协调如何在仅有持续的个体层面选择下产生。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个多层次选择的计算模型，其中群体层面选择塑造了一个由所有经历个体层面选择的群体成员共享的共同基质和突变算子。我们还将这一过程置于一个具身生态中，其中不同的资源渠道并非分离，而是通过相同的行为原语耦合在一起。这些渠道被分为正和摄入渠道和零和再分配渠道。我们调查了在由出生和死亡驱动的更替下，这种设置是否能产生角色分化。我们发现在一个学习的生态中，在群体层面，两个渠道都保持被占用，并且避免了崩溃为单一获取模式。尽管零和渠道的使用并未被群体层面选择直接优化，但其使用量在几代内增加。渠道占用也在个体（boid）的生命周期内波动。消融研究表明，大部分基线性能由遗传的行为基础承载，而学习的变异过程在饱和前提供了较小但系统的改进。总而言之，这些结果表明，多层次选择可以使处于公共资源环境中的群体，通过在持续更替下对耦合渠道的差异化使用，从而规避公地悲剧。
tldr: 在多层次选择下，群体可以通过分化角色利用耦合的资源渠道，从而避免公地悲剧，即使在持续的个体层面选择下也能实现。
ai_comments: 本文通过引入一个结合了多层次选择和具身生态的计算模型，创新性地解释了在持续个体层面选择下，群体如何通过角色分化避免公地悲剧。其重要性在于提供了一个机制来理解复杂社会行为的演化，特别是在资源管理和合作方面。该模型揭示了遗传基础与学习过程在行为适应中的协同作用，为理解群体协调和可持续性提供了新的视角。
motivation: 非合作代理群体若都试图最大化同一资源渠道，可能导致“公地悲剧”。自然界中，群体常通过分化角色来避免这种崩溃，但尚不清楚这种协调如何在持续的个体层面选择下产生。
method: 引入了一个多层次选择的计算模型，其中群体层面选择塑造了所有经历个体层面选择的群体成员共享的共同基质和突变算子。该过程被置于一个具身生态中，其中不同的资源渠道并非分离，而是通过相同的行为原语耦合在一起。这些渠道被分为正和（positive-sum）摄入渠道和零和（zero-sum）再分配渠道。
results: 发现在学习的生态中，在群体层面，两个渠道都保持被占用，避免了崩溃为单一获取模式。零和渠道的使用量在几代内增加，尽管它并未被群体层面选择直接优化。渠道占用也在个体（boid）的生命周期内波动。消融研究表明，大部分基线性能由遗传的行为基础承载，而学习的变异过程在饱和前提供了较小但系统的改进。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，多层次选择可以使处于公共资源环境中的群体，通过在持续更替下对耦合渠道的差异化使用，从而规避公地悲剧。

title: DVGT-2: Vision-Geometry-Action Model for Autonomous Driving at Scale
authors: Sicheng Zuo, Zixun Xie, Wenzhao Zheng, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Hanbing Li, Long Chen, Zhi-Xin Yang, Jiwen Lu
abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has evolved from the conventional paradigm based on sparse perception into vision-language-action (VLA) models, which focus on learning language descriptions as an auxiliary task to facilitate planning. In this paper, we propose an alternative Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) paradigm that advocates dense 3D geometry as the critical cue for autonomous driving. As vehicles operate in a 3D world, we think dense 3D geometry provides the most comprehensive information for decision-making. However, most existing geometry reconstruction methods (e.g., DVGT) rely on computationally expensive batch processing of multi-frame inputs and cannot be applied to online planning. To address this, we introduce a streaming Driving Visual Geometry Transformer (DVGT-2), which processes inputs in an online manner and jointly outputs dense geometry and trajectory planning for the current frame. We employ temporal causal attention and cache historical features to support on-the-fly inference. To further enhance efficiency, we propose a sliding-window streaming strategy and use historical caches within a certain interval to avoid repetitive computations. Despite the faster speed, DVGT-2 achieves superior geometry reconstruction performance on various datasets. The same trained DVGT-2 can be directly applied to planning across diverse camera configurations without fine-tuning, including closed-loop NAVSIM and open-loop nuScenes benchmarks.
zh_title: DVGT-2：面向大规模自动驾驶的视觉-几何-行动模型
translation: 端到端自动驾驶已从基于稀疏感知的传统范式演变为视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型，后者侧重于学习语言描述作为辅助任务以促进规划。在本文中，我们提出了一种替代的视觉-几何-行动（VGA）范式，主张密集三维几何是自动驾驶的关键线索。由于车辆运行在三维世界中，我们认为密集三维几何为决策提供了最全面的信息。然而，大多数现有的几何重建方法（如DVGT）依赖于多帧输入的昂贵批处理，无法应用于在线规划。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了流式驾驶视觉几何Transformer（DVGT-2），它以在线方式处理输入，并联合输出当前帧的密集几何结构和轨迹规划。我们采用时间因果注意力并缓存历史特征以支持即时推理。为了进一步提高效率，我们提出了滑动窗口流式策略，并在特定间隔内使用历史缓存以避免重复计算。尽管速度更快，DVGT-2在各种数据集上仍实现了卓越的几何重建性能。训练好的DVGT-2可直接应用于不同相机配置的规划任务，无需微调，包括闭环NAVSIM和开环nuScenes基准测试。
tldr: DVGT-2通过引入流式架构和密集三维几何建模，实现了高效、实时的自动驾驶轨迹规划，优于传统的视觉-语言-行动方案。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种从视觉-语言-行动（VLA）向视觉-几何-行动（VGA）范式转变的思路，强调了三维几何信息在自动驾驶决策中的核心地位。DVGT-2通过引入流式处理机制和历史缓存，成功解决了传统几何重建方法计算成本高、无法实时推理的痛点，展示了在多种基准测试中优异的通用性和计算效率。
motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶多采用视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型，忽略了三维世界中几何信息的关键作用；而现有的几何重建方法计算成本过高，无法满足在线规划的需求。
method: 提出视觉-几何-行动（VGA）范式；设计流式Driving Visual Geometry Transformer (DVGT-2)；采用时间因果注意力机制和历史缓存；引入滑动窗口流式处理策略以避免重复计算。
results: DVGT-2实现了高效的在线几何重建与轨迹规划；在多种数据集上表现出卓越的重建性能；无需微调即可适应多种相机配置，并在NAVSIM和nuScenes基准测试中表现优异。
conclusion: DVGT-2成功证明了将密集三维几何作为自动驾驶核心线索的可行性，并通过流式处理架构实现了高效、实时的在线规划，为端到端自动驾驶提供了一种强有力的替代方案。

title: Cost-Penalized Fitness in FMA-Orchestrated Mixture of Experts: Experimental Evidence for Molecular Memory in Domain Adaptation
authors: Martin Jaraiz
abstract: We present experimental results from seven controlled runs of nanoFMT, a Free-Market Algorithm (FMA) orchestrated transformer with dynamic Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) management. The experiments address a fundamental question for advanced LLM development: how should an MoE system manage its expert pool when operating at full capacity under changing data distributions? We demonstrate that cost-penalized fitness metrics, combined with a linear grace period for newborn experts, produce a system that accumulates domain expertise through diversification rather than replacement. The central result is a round-trip domain shift experiment showing 9-11x faster recovery when returning to a previously learned domain, with zero expert births or replacements required. This "molecular memory" effect -- where dormant experts survive and reactivate when their domain returns -- has no analogue in current MoE management approaches. A preliminary cost analysis estimates annual savings of $39.1M and 27.1 GWh energy reduction for an OpenAI-scale provider under a moderate scenario.
zh_title: FMA编排的专家混合模型中成本惩罚适应度：领域适应中分子记忆的实验证据
translation: 我们展示了nanoFMT（一种由自由市场算法FMA编排的具有动态专家混合模型MoE管理的Transformer）七次受控运行的实验结果。这些实验解决了先进LLM开发的一个基本问题：当数据分布发生变化时，一个全容量运行的MoE系统应如何管理其专家池？我们证明，成本惩罚适应度指标，结合新生专家的线性宽限期，能够产生一个通过多样化而非替换来积累领域专业知识的系统。核心结果是一个往返领域转移实验，显示在返回到先前学习的领域时，恢复速度快9-11倍，且无需新生专家或替换。这种“分子记忆”效应——即休眠专家在其领域返回时存活并重新激活——在当前的MoE管理方法中没有类似物。初步成本分析估计，在适度情景下，对于OpenAI规模的提供商，每年可节省3910万美元，并减少27.1 GWh的能源消耗。
tldr: 该研究通过实验证明，在FMA编排的专家混合模型中，结合成本惩罚适应度指标和新生专家宽限期，可以实现领域适应中的“分子记忆”效应，即休眠专家在领域返回时能被重新激活，从而显著加快恢复速度并带来巨大的成本和能源节约。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的MoE管理方法，通过引入成本惩罚适应度和新生专家宽限期，实现了“分子记忆”效应，这在现有MoE方法中是独一无二的。这种方法不仅显著提高了领域适应的恢复效率，还带来了巨大的潜在经济和环境效益，对于未来大型语言模型（LLM）的开发具有重要意义。其创新点在于从经济学角度（自由市场算法）管理计算资源，并发现了一种类似生物记忆的机制。
motivation: 先进LLM开发面临一个基本问题：在数据分布变化时，全容量运行的MoE系统应如何管理其专家池？
method: 研究通过七次受控运行的nanoFMT（一种由自由市场算法FMA编排的动态专家混合模型MoE的Transformer）进行实验。采用成本惩罚适应度指标，并为新生专家设置线性宽限期。
results: 系统通过多样化而非替换来积累领域专业知识。核心结果是往返领域转移实验显示，返回到先前学习的领域时，恢复速度快9-11倍，且无需新生专家或替换。这种“分子记忆”效应（休眠专家在领域返回时存活并重新激活）在当前的MoE管理方法中没有类似物。初步成本分析估计，在适度情景下，对于OpenAI规模的提供商，每年可节省3910万美元，并减少27.1 GWh的能源消耗。
conclusion: 成本惩罚适应度指标结合新生专家宽限期，能使MoE系统在领域适应中展现出“分子记忆”效应，即休眠专家可在其领域返回时被重新激活，从而显著提高恢复效率并带来巨大的经济和环境效益。

title: Multicentric thrombus segmentation using an attention-based recurrent network with gradual modality dropout
authors: Sofia Vargas-Ibarra, Vincent Vigneron, Hichem Maaref, Sonia Garcia-Salicetti
abstract: Detecting and delineating tiny targets in 3D brain scans is a central yet under-addressed challenge in medical imaging.In ischemic stroke, for instance, the culprit thrombus is small, low-contrast, and variably expressed across modalities(e.g., susceptibility-weighted T2 blooming, diffusion restriction on DWI/ADC), while real-world multi-center dataintroduce domain shifts, anisotropy, and frequent missing sequences. We introduce a methodology that couples an attention-based recurrent segmentation network (UpAttLLSTM), a training schedule that progressively increases the difficulty of hetero-modal learning, with gradual modality dropout, UpAttLLSTM aggregates context across slices via recurrent units (2.5D) and uses attention gates to fuse complementary cues across available sequences, making it robust to anisotropy and class imbalance. Gradual modality dropout systematically simulates site heterogeneity,noise, and missing modalities during training, acting as both augmentation and regularization to improve multi-center generalization. On a monocentric cohort, our approach detects thrombi in >90% of cases with a Dice score of 0.65. In a multi-center setting with missing modalities, it achieves-80% detection with a Dice score around 0.35. Beyond stroke, the proposed methodology directly transfers to other small-lesion tasks in 3D medical imaging where targets are scarce, subtle, and modality-dependent
zh_title: 基于注意力循环网络与渐进式模态丢弃的多中心血栓分割研究
translation: 在3D脑部扫描中检测和勾画微小目标是医学影像领域一个核心但尚未得到充分解决的挑战。以缺血性卒中为例，其致病血栓体积小、对比度低，且在不同模态（如加权T2序列、DWI/ADC弥散受限）下的表现各异，而真实世界的多中心数据引入了域偏移、各向异性和频繁的序列缺失问题。我们引入了一种结合注意力循环分割网络（UpAttLLSTM）的方法，该方法采用一种逐步增加异构模态学习难度的训练计划，并结合了渐进式模态丢弃策略。UpAttLLSTM通过循环单元（2.5D）聚合切片间的上下文，并利用注意力门融合可用序列间的互补线索，从而对各向异性和类不平衡具有鲁棒性。渐进式模态丢弃在训练过程中系统地模拟了中心异质性、噪声和缺失模态，作为一种数据增强和正则化手段，提高了多中心环境下的泛化能力。在单中心队列中，我们的方法在90%以上的病例中检测到了血栓，Dice得分为0.65。在存在缺失模态的多中心设置中，该方法实现了约80%的检测率，Dice得分约为0.35。除了卒中，所提出的方法可以直接迁移到3D医学影像中其他目标稀少、细微且依赖模态的小病灶检测任务中。
tldr: 提出了一种结合注意力循环网络与渐进式模态丢弃策略的新方法，有效解决了多中心医学影像中微小目标分割及模态缺失的难题。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地结合了注意力机制、循环神经网络以及渐进式模态丢弃策略，有效解决了医学图像中多中心数据缺失、类不平衡及小目标难以检测的问题。其方法不仅在缺血性卒中血栓检测中表现稳健，还具有良好的跨任务迁移能力，为处理复杂医学影像任务提供了新思路。
motivation: 医学影像中微小目标（如缺血性卒中血栓）在不同模态下表现差异大，且多中心数据存在域偏移、各向异性及模态缺失等严重挑战，现有的方法难以有效解决这些问题。
method: 提出了一种名为UpAttLLSTM的注意力循环分割网络，利用循环单元聚合切片间上下文，并结合注意力门融合模态特征；同时引入“渐进式模态丢弃”训练策略，通过模拟真实场景下的数据缺失、噪声和异质性，增强模型的泛化能力。
results: 在单中心队列中，血栓检测率超过90%，Dice得分为0.65；在包含缺失模态的多中心设置下，检测率达到约80%，Dice得分约为0.35。
conclusion: 本研究提出的UpAttLLSTM架构配合渐进式模态丢弃策略，能够有效应对多中心、多模态医学图像中微小目标的分割难题，显著提升了模型在缺失模态情况下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: Misconception Acquisition Dynamics in Large Language Models
authors: Naiming Liu, Xinghe Chen, Richard Baraniuk, Mrinmaya Sachan, Shashank Sonkar
abstract: Effective educational AI depends on modeling student misconceptions. Such models enable realistic learner simulation and diagnostic, adaptive tutoring. However, instruction-tuning large language models on student responses containing misconception errors can degrade reasoning abilities, creating a tension between faithful misconception modeling and preserving correct reasoning in other contexts. To support both learner simulation and tutoring, we study two misconception-aware models: the Novice Student Misconception Model, trained to acquire a single misconception for simulating an individual student, and the Expert Tutor Misconception Model, trained on multiple misconceptions to capture the error patterns a tutor encounters across students. To study the misconception acquisition dynamics of both models, we develop MalAlgoLib, a library that generates algebra problems with correct solution traces and misconception-specific erroneous traces. Our experiments across three LLMs reveal that the student and the tutor model exhibit fundamentally different misconception acquisition dynamics. For the student model, a single misconception is not learned as a context-specific behavior. Models overapply it across problems, degrading correct-solving accuracy unless training includes correct examples to enforce boundaries. In contrast, the tutor model can learn multiple misconceptions jointly without sacrificing correct-solving accuracy. Critically, intermediate reasoning steps are the bottleneck. With final-answer supervision alone, models cannot learn where error enters the solution, so neither the student model nor the tutor model acquires misconceptions regardless of data size. Together, these results, enabled by MalAlgoLib, provide an interpretable account of misconception acquisition under instruction tuning and guidance for training misconception-aware LLMs while preserving correct reasoning.
zh_title: 大型语言模型中误解的获取动态
translation: 有效的教育AI依赖于对学生误解的建模。这些模型能够实现逼真的学习者模拟和诊断性、自适应辅导。然而，在包含误解错误的学生回答上对大型语言模型进行指令微调可能会损害其推理能力，这在忠实建模误解和在其他情境中保持正确推理之间造成了矛盾。为了支持学习者模拟和辅导，我们研究了两种误解感知模型：新手学生误解模型，训练其获取单一误解以模拟个体学生；以及专家导师误解模型，训练其获取多种误解以捕捉导师在学生身上遇到的错误模式。为了研究这两种模型的误解获取动态，我们开发了MalAlgoLib，这是一个生成代数问题及其正确解题过程和特定误解的错误解题过程的库。我们在三种LLM上的实验表明，学生模型和导师模型表现出根本不同的误解获取动态。对于学生模型，单一误解不会作为特定上下文行为来学习。模型会在问题之间过度应用它，除非训练中包含正确示例来强制边界，否则会降低正确解题的准确性。相比之下，导师模型可以联合学习多种误解而不会牺牲正确解题的准确性。关键在于中间推理步骤是瓶颈。仅通过最终答案监督，模型无法学习错误在哪里进入解决方案，因此学生模型和导师模型都无法获取误解，无论数据量大小。总而言之，这些由MalAlgoLib实现的结果，为指令微调下误解的获取提供了解释性说明，并为在保留正确推理的同时训练误解感知型LLM提供了指导。
tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）中学生和导师两种误解模型的获取动态。发现学生模型易过度泛化单一误解，而导师模型能有效学习多种误解。关键在于中间推理步骤的监督，仅靠最终答案无法使模型习得误解。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过区分学生模型和导师模型，深入探讨了LLM学习和泛化误解的机制，具有创新性。特别指出中间推理步骤是学习误解的关键瓶颈，为未来设计更有效的教育AI系统，在模拟学生错误的同时保持LLM的正确推理能力，提供了重要的理论基础和实践指导。MalAlgoLib的开发也为相关研究提供了有价值的工具。
motivation: 有效的教育AI需要建模学生误解以实现逼真的学习者模拟和诊断性、自适应辅导。然而，在包含误解错误的学生回答上对大型语言模型进行指令微调可能会损害其推理能力，这在忠实建模误解和在其他情境中保持正确推理之间造成了矛盾。
method: 开发了两种误解感知模型：新手学生误解模型（NSMM），训练其获取单一误解以模拟个体学生；专家导师误解模型（ETMM），训练其获取多种误解以捕捉导师遇到的错误模式。开发了MalAlgoLib库，用于生成代数问题及其正确解题过程和特定误解的错误解题过程。在三种LLM上进行了实验。
results: 学生模型和导师模型表现出根本不同的误解获取动态。学生模型不会将单一误解作为特定上下文行为来学习，而是会过度泛化，除非训练中包含正确示例来强制边界，否则会降低正确解题的准确性。导师模型可以联合学习多种误解而不会牺牲正确解题的准确性。中间推理步骤是瓶颈，仅通过最终答案监督，模型无法学习错误在哪里进入解决方案，导致学生模型和导师模型都无法获取误解，无论数据量大小。
conclusion: 这些结果，由MalAlgoLib实现，为指令微调下误解的获取提供了解释性说明，并为在保留正确推理的同时训练误解感知型LLM提供了指导。

title: Emotion Entanglement and Bayesian Inference for Multi-Dimensional Emotion Understanding
authors: Hemanth Kotaprolu, Kishan Maharaj, Raey Zhao, Abhijit Mishra, Pushpak Bhattacharyya
abstract: Understanding emotions in natural language is inherently a multi-dimensional reasoning problem, where multiple affective signals interact through context, interpersonal relations, and situational cues. However, most existing emotion understanding benchmarks rely on short texts and predefined emotion labels, reducing this process to independent label prediction and ignoring the structured dependencies among emotions. To address this limitation, we introduce Emotional Scenarios (EmoScene), a theory-grounded benchmark of 4,731 context-rich scenarios annotated with an 8-dimensional emotion vector derived from Plutchik's basic emotions. We evaluate six instruction-tuned large language models in a zero-shot setting and observe modest performance, with the best model achieving a Macro F1 of 0.501, highlighting the difficulty of context-aware multi-label emotion prediction. Motivated by the observation that emotions rarely occur independently, we further propose an entanglement-aware Bayesian inference framework that incorporates emotion co-occurrence statistics to perform joint posterior inference over the emotion vector. This lightweight post-processing improves structural consistency of predictions and yields notable gains for weaker models (e.g., +0.051 Macro F1 for Qwen2.5-7B). EmoScene therefore provides a challenging benchmark for studying multi-dimensional emotion understanding and the limitations of current language models.
zh_title: 情感纠缠与贝叶斯推断用于多维情感理解
translation: 在自然语言中理解情感本质上是一个多维推理问题，其中多个情感信号通过上下文、人际关系和情境线索相互作用。然而，大多数现有情感理解基准依赖于短文本和预定义情感标签，将这一过程简化为独立标签预测，并忽略了情感之间的结构化依赖。为解决这一局限性，我们引入了情感场景（EmoScene），这是一个基于理论的基准，包含4,731个上下文丰富的场景，并用普拉奇克基本情绪衍生的8维情感向量进行标注。我们在零样本设置下评估了六个指令调优的大型语言模型，观察到其性能平平，最佳模型仅达到0.501的Macro F1分数，这凸显了上下文感知多标签情感预测的难度。受情感很少独立发生的观察启发，我们进一步提出了一个纠缠感知的贝叶斯推断框架，该框架结合情感共现统计数据，对情感向量进行联合后验推断。这种轻量级后处理改进了预测的结构一致性，并为较弱的模型带来了显著的收益（例如，Qwen2.5-7B的Macro F1提高了0.051）。因此，EmoScene为研究多维情感理解和当前语言模型的局限性提供了一个具有挑战性的基准。
tldr: 本文提出了一个新基准EmoScene和一个贝叶斯推断框架，以解决现有语言模型在多维情感理解中忽略情感结构依赖性的问题。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于其对多维情感理解中情感结构依赖性的关注，这与传统独立标签预测方法形成对比。EmoScene基准的引入为该领域提供了一个更具挑战性和真实性的评估工具。贝叶斯推断框架作为一种轻量级后处理方法，有效地利用了情感共现知识，为改进现有语言模型在复杂情感任务上的表现提供了一个有价值的途径。
motivation: 现有情感理解基准依赖短文本和预定义标签，将情感理解简化为独立标签预测，忽略了情感之间通过上下文、人际关系和情境线索相互作用的结构化依赖性，这限制了对自然语言中多维情感的理解。
method: 引入了情感场景（EmoScene）基准，这是一个基于理论的、包含4,731个上下文丰富的场景，并用普拉奇克基本情绪衍生的8维情感向量进行标注。进一步提出了一个纠缠感知的贝叶斯推断框架，该框架结合情感共现统计数据，对情感向量进行联合后验推断。
results: 在零样本设置下，六个指令调优的大型语言模型在EmoScene上的表现平平，最佳模型仅达到0.501的Macro F1分数。所提出的贝叶斯推断框架提高了预测的结构一致性，并为较弱的模型带来了显著的性能提升（例如，Qwen2.5-7B的Macro F1提高了0.051）。
conclusion: EmoScene为研究多维情感理解和当前语言模型的局限性提供了一个具有挑战性的基准。纠缠感知的贝叶斯推断框架通过整合情感共现统计数据，能够有效提高情感预测的结构一致性和性能。

title: Optimal Brain Decomposition for Accurate LLM Low-Rank Approximation
authors: Yuhang Li, Donghyun Lee, Ruokai Yin, Priyadarshini Panda
abstract: Low-rank decomposition has emerged as an important problem in Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuning and inference. Through Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), the weight matrix can be factorized into low-rank spaces optimally. Previously, a common practice was to decompose the weight in the activation-whitened space, and then achieve satisfying results. In this work, we propose Optimal Brain Decomposition LLM (OBD-LLM), which studies the decomposition problem in the model space by utilizing second-order Hessian information. Through a rigorous Kronecker-factorization of the Hessian, we show that the decomposition needs to consider both input and output information of the layer, and achieves much better decomposition results compared to input only method. Our loss-aware decomposition method involves a bi-directional whitening on the weight matrix. As a result, OBD-LLM is a closed-form solution for the optimal decomposition of weights in the language model. Remarkably, we achieve ~20-40\% better results than previous state-of-the-art decomposition methods, the SVD-LLM.
zh_title: 用于精确LLM低秩近似的最优脑分解
translation: 低秩分解已成为大型语言模型（LLM）微调和推理中的一个重要问题。通过奇异值分解（SVD），权重矩阵可以被最优地分解到低秩空间中。以前，常见的做法是在激活白化空间中分解权重，然后取得令人满意的结果。在这项工作中，我们提出了最优脑分解LLM（OBD-LLM），它通过利用二阶Hessian信息在模型空间中研究分解问题。通过对Hessian进行严格的Kronecker分解，我们表明分解需要考虑层的输入和输出信息，并且与仅考虑输入的方法相比，取得了更好的分解结果。我们这种损失感知的分解方法涉及对权重矩阵的双向白化。因此，OBD-LLM是语言模型中权重最优分解的闭式解。值得注意的是，我们比以前最先进的分解方法SVD-LLM取得了约20-40%的更好结果。
tldr: 本文提出OBD-LLM，一种新的LLM低秩分解方法，利用二阶Hessian信息和双向白化，比现有SOTA方法效果显著提升。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于，它通过在模型空间中利用二阶Hessian信息并引入双向白化，为LLM的低秩近似提供了一个理论上更完善、性能更优越的闭式解决方案。这种方法考虑了层的输入和输出信息，克服了以往仅依赖输入信息方法的局限性，显著提升了分解的准确性，对LLM的效率和性能优化具有重要意义。
motivation: 低秩分解在大型语言模型（LLM）的微调和推理中是一个重要问题。以往的实践通常在激活白化空间中进行权重分解以获得良好结果。本文旨在通过在模型空间中利用二阶Hessian信息来优化分解问题，以实现更精确的LLM低秩近似。
method: 本文提出了最优脑分解LLM（OBD-LLM）。该方法通过利用二阶Hessian信息在模型空间中研究分解问题。通过对Hessian进行严格的Kronecker分解，表明分解需要同时考虑层的输入和输出信息，并涉及对权重矩阵的双向白化。OBD-LLM为语言模型中权重的最优分解提供了一个闭式解。
results: OBD-LLM比以前最先进的分解方法SVD-LLM取得了约20-40%的更好结果。
conclusion: OBD-LLM通过在模型空间中利用二阶Hessian信息和双向白化，提供了一种最优的、闭式解的LLM权重分解方法，显著优于现有技术，实现了更精确的低秩近似。

title: Continual Vision-Language Learning for Remote Sensing: Benchmarking and Analysis
authors: Xingxing Weng, Ruifeng Ni, Chao Pang, XiangYu Hao, Yishan Wang, Xiaokang Zhang, Wei Xu, Gui-Song Xia
abstract: Current remote sensing vision-language models (RS VLMs) demonstrate impressive performance in image interpretation but rely on static training data, limiting their ability to accommodate continuously emerging sensing modalities and downstream tasks. This exposes a fundamental challenge: enabling RS VLMs to continually adapt without catastrophic forgetting. Despite its practical importance, the continual learning capability of RS VLMs remains underexplored, and no dedicated benchmark currently exists. In this work, we present CLeaRS, a comprehensive benchmark for continual vision-language learning in remote sensing. CLeaRS comprises 10 curated subsets with over 207k image-text pairs, spanning diverse interpretation tasks, sensing modalities, and application scenarios. We further define three evaluation protocols: long-horizon, modality-incremental, and task-incremental settings, to systematically assess continual adaptation. Extensive benchmarking of diverse vision-language models reveals catastrophic forgetting across all settings. Moreover, representative continual learning methods, when adapted to RS VLMs, exhibit limited effectiveness in handling task, instruction, and modality transitions. Our findings underscore the need for developing continual learning methods tailored to RS VLMs.
zh_title: 遥感领域的持续视觉-语言学习：基准测试与分析
translation: 当前的遥感视觉-语言模型（RS VLMs）在图像解释方面表现出色，但依赖于静态训练数据，这限制了它们适应持续出现的新感知模态和下游任务的能力。这暴露了一个基本挑战：如何使RS VLMs持续适应而又不发生灾难性遗忘。尽管其具有实际重要性，但RS VLMs的持续学习能力仍未得到充分探索，并且目前还没有专门的基准。在这项工作中，我们提出了CLeaRS，一个用于遥感持续视觉-语言学习的综合基准。CLeaRS包含10个精心策划的子集，拥有超过20.7万个图像-文本对，涵盖了不同的解释任务、感知模态和应用场景。我们进一步定义了三种评估协议：长周期、模态增量和任务增量设置，以系统地评估持续适应能力。对各种视觉-语言模型进行的大量基准测试揭示了在所有设置下都存在灾难性遗忘。此外，当代表性的持续学习方法应用于RS VLMs时，它们在处理任务、指令和模态转换方面的效果有限。我们的研究结果强调了开发专门针对RS VLMs的持续学习方法的必要性。
tldr: 现有的遥感视觉-语言模型(RS VLMs)在图像解释方面表现出色，但依赖静态训练数据，限制了其适应持续出现的新感知模态和下游任务的能力，导致灾难性遗忘。本文提出了CLeaRS，一个用于遥感持续视觉-语言学习的综合基准，包含10个子集，超过20.7万个图像-文本对，并定义了三种评估协议。基准测试结果表明，RS VLMs在所有设置下都存在灾难性遗忘，现有持续学习方法效果有限，强调了开发专门针对RS VLMs的持续学习方法的必要性。
ai_comments: 这项工作具有重要意义，因为它首次为遥感领域的持续视觉-语言学习建立了一个全面的基准。该基准的提出填补了该领域的一个空白，并为未来研究提供了评估和比较新方法的标准平台。发现灾难性遗忘的普遍性以及现有持续学习方法效果有限，为未来的研究指明了方向，即需要开发专门为RS VLMs设计的持续学习策略。
motivation: 当前的遥感视觉-语言模型(RS VLMs)依赖静态训练数据，这限制了它们适应不断涌现的感知模态和下游任务的能力。这暴露了一个基本挑战：如何在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下使RS VLMs持续适应。尽管持续学习在遥感领域具有实际重要性，但RS VLMs的持续学习能力尚未得到充分探索，并且目前还没有专门的基准。
method: 本文提出了CLeaRS，一个用于遥感持续视觉-语言学习的综合基准。CLeaRS包含10个精心策划的子集，拥有超过20.7万个图像-文本对，涵盖了不同的解释任务、感知模态和应用场景。我们进一步定义了三种评估协议：长周期、模态增量和任务增量设置，以系统地评估持续适应能力。对各种视觉-语言模型进行了广泛的基准测试，并将代表性的持续学习方法应用于RS VLMs。
results: 对各种视觉-语言模型进行的大量基准测试揭示了在所有设置下都存在灾难性遗忘。此外，当代表性的持续学习方法应用于RS VLMs时，它们在处理任务、指令和模态转换方面的效果有限。
conclusion: 本文的研究结果强调了开发专门针对遥感视觉-语言模型(RS VLMs)的持续学习方法的必要性。

title: Min-Max Grassmannian Optimization for Online Subspace Tracking
authors: Shreyas Bharadwaj, Bamdev Mishra, Cyrus Mostajeran, Alberto Padoan, Jeremy Coulson, Ravi Banavar
abstract: This paper discusses robustness guarantees for online tracking of time-varying subspaces from noisy data. Building on recent work in optimization over a Grassmannian manifold, we introduce a new approach for robust subspace tracking by modeling data uncertainty in a Grassmannian ball. The robust subspace tracking problem is cast into a min-max optimization framework, for which we derive a closed-form solution for the worst-case subspace, enabling a geometric robustness adjustment that is both analytically tractable and computationally efficient, unlike iterative convex relaxations. The resulting algorithm, GeRoST (Geometrically Robust Subspace Tracking), is validated on two case studies: tracking a linear time-varying system and online foreground-background separation in video.
comment: Submitted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control, December 15-18 2026, Honolulu, Hawaii, USA
zh_title: 在线子空间跟踪的最小-最大格拉斯曼优化
translation: 本文讨论了从噪声数据中在线跟踪时变子空间的鲁棒性保证问题。在格拉斯曼流形上优化最新工作的基础上，我们通过在格拉斯曼球中建模数据不确定性，引入了一种鲁棒子空间跟踪的新方法。鲁棒子空间跟踪问题被转化为一个最小-最大优化框架，我们为此推导出了最坏情况子空间的闭式解，从而实现了一种几何鲁棒性调整，该调整在分析上可处理且计算高效，这与迭代凸松弛方法不同。由此产生的算法GeRoST（几何鲁棒子空间跟踪）在两个案例研究中得到了验证：跟踪线性时变系统和视频中的在线前景-背景分离。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于最小-最大格拉斯曼优化框架的鲁棒在线子空间跟踪新方法GeRoST，通过建模数据不确定性并推导出最坏情况子空间的闭式解，实现了分析上可处理且计算高效的几何鲁棒性调整。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将鲁棒子空间跟踪问题转化为最小-最大格拉斯曼优化框架，并成功推导出了最坏情况子空间的闭式解。这使得算法在保持鲁棒性的同时，具有分析可处理性和计算高效性，避免了传统迭代凸松弛方法的复杂性。该方法为在线子空间跟踪提供了一种新颖且实用的解决方案。
motivation: 讨论了从噪声数据中在线跟踪时变子空间的鲁棒性保证问题，旨在解决数据不确定性对子空间跟踪的影响。
method: 基于格拉斯曼流形上的优化工作，引入了一种通过在格拉斯曼球中建模数据不确定性来实现鲁棒子空间跟踪的新方法。将鲁棒子空间跟踪问题转化为一个最小-最大优化框架，并推导出了最坏情况子空间的闭式解。该方法称为GeRoST（几何鲁棒子空间跟踪）。
results: 推导出的闭式解使得几何鲁棒性调整在分析上可处理且计算高效，优于迭代凸松弛方法。该算法在跟踪线性时变系统和视频中在线前景-背景分离这两个案例研究中得到了验证。
conclusion: 通过引入最小-最大格拉斯曼优化框架和推导闭式解，本文提出了一种在分析上可处理且计算高效的鲁棒在线子空间跟踪方法（GeRoST），并在实际应用中得到验证。

title: Yet Even Less Is Even Better For Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding LLMs
authors: Yang Ye, Jingyuan Tan, Tianyue Jiang, Ruizhe Ye, Qiankun He, Jiarui Yang, Jian Dong, Sicong Liang, Chongjian Yue, Peibai Xu, Lufan Lu, Taotao Qian, Junbao Hu, Yuechan Hao, Ensheng Shi, Qi Zhang, Yi Hao, Na Fan, Xin Tan, Shuai Yao, Zhiwei Shen, Zongchen Li, Yanlin Wang, Chong Chen, Yuchi Ma
abstract: Training effective software engineering agents requires large volumes of task-specific trajectories, incurring substantial data construction costs. Inspired by the "Less-Is-More" hypothesis in mathematical reasoning, we investigate its extension to agentic scenarios and propose an end-to-end training framework that achieves superior agentic capabilities with fewer but higher-quality training trajectories. This is achieved via STITCH (Sliding-memory Trajectory Inference and Task Chunking Heuristic), a coarse-to-fine mechanism that filters low-value noise and retains decision-critical tokens to maximize training signal quality. We conduct experiments across multiple agent frameworks (e.g., mini-SWE-agent, MSWE-agent), model scales (30B to 355B), and multilingual settings (Python, Java, and ArkTS). On SWE-bench Verified, models trained with STITCH achieve up to 63.16% relative improvement over base models. On Multi-SWE-bench (Java), MiniMax-M2.5-STITCH achieves 43.75% with our CodeArts Agent scaffold (+16.67%). On HarmonyOS (ArkTS), GLM-4.7-STITCH improves the compilation pass rate to 61.31% (+43.34%) with less than 1K training trajectories. Our results confirm that the "Less-Is-More" paradigm generalizes effectively to complex agentic tasks across diverse languages and model scales.
zh_title: 对于代理、推理和编码LLM而言，更少即更好
translation: 训练有效的软件工程代理需要大量的任务特定轨迹，这导致了高昂的数据构建成本。受数学推理中“更少即更好”假说的启发，我们研究了其在代理场景中的扩展，并提出了一个端到端训练框架，该框架通过更少但更高质量的训练轨迹实现了卓越的代理能力。这通过STITCH（滑动记忆轨迹推理和任务分块启发式）实现，STITCH是一种从粗到精的机制，用于过滤低价值噪声并保留决策关键令牌，以最大化训练信号质量。我们在多个代理框架（例如，mini-SWE-agent、MSWE-agent）、模型规模（30B到355B）和多语言设置（Python、Java和ArkTS）中进行了实验。在SWE-bench Verified上，使用STITCH训练的模型比基础模型相对提升高达63.16%。在Multi-SWE-bench (Java)上，MiniMax-M2.5-STITCH通过我们的CodeArts Agent脚手架实现了43.75%（+16.67%）。在HarmonyOS (ArkTS)上，GLM-4.7-STITCH在不到1K的训练轨迹下，将编译通过率提高到61.31%（+43.34%）。我们的结果证实，“更少即更好”范式能够有效推广到跨不同语言和模型规模的复杂代理任务。
tldr: 通过STITCH框架，使用更少但更高质量的训练轨迹，可以显著提升软件工程代理LLM的性能。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将“更少即更好”的理念应用于软件工程代理LLM的训练，通过STITCH框架有效解决了高昂的数据构建成本问题。其核心在于通过智能过滤机制提升训练数据质量而非数量，这对于资源受限或需要快速迭代的LLM应用具有重要意义。实验结果在多语言和多框架下均表现出显著提升，证明了该方法的普适性和有效性。
motivation: 训练有效的软件工程代理需要大量的任务特定轨迹，这导致了高昂的数据构建成本。
method: 本文提出STITCH（滑动记忆轨迹推理和任务分块启发式）框架，这是一个从粗到精的机制，用于过滤低价值噪声并保留决策关键令牌，以最大化训练信号质量。它受数学推理中“更少即更好”假说的启发，旨在通过更少但更高质量的训练轨迹实现卓越的代理能力。
results: 在SWE-bench Verified上，使用STITCH训练的模型比基础模型相对提升高达63.16%。在Multi-SWE-bench (Java)上，MiniMax-M2.5-STITCH通过CodeArts Agent脚手架实现了43.75%的性能（+16.67%）。在HarmonyOS (ArkTS)上，GLM-4.7-STITCH在不到1K的训练轨迹下，将编译通过率提高到61.31%（+43.34%）。
conclusion: 实验结果证实，“更少即更好”范式能够有效推广到跨不同语言和模型规模的复杂代理任务。

title: Bridging RL and MPC for mixed-integer optimal control with application to Formula 1 race strategies
authors: Joschua Wüthrich, Romir Damle, Giona Fieni, Melanie N. Zeilinger, Christopher H. Onder, Andrea Carron
abstract: We propose a hybrid reinforcement learning (RL) and model predictive control (MPC) framework for mixed-integer optimal control, where discrete variables enter the cost and dynamics but not the constraints. Existing hierarchical approaches use RL only for the discrete action space, leaving continuous optimization to MPC. Unlike these methods, we train the RL agent on the full hybrid action space, ensuring consistency with the cost of the underlying Markov decision process. During deployment, the RL actor is rolled out over the prediction horizon to parametrize an integer-free nonlinear MPC through the discrete action sequence and provide a continuous warm-start. The learned critic serves as a terminal cost to capture long-term performance. We prove recursive feasibility, and validate the framework on a Formula 1 race strategy problem. The hybrid method achieves near-optimal performance relative to an offline mixed-integer nonlinear program benchmark, outperforming a standalone RL agent. Moreover, the hybrid scheme enables adaptation to unseen disturbances through modular MPC extensions at zero retraining cost.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures; This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
zh_title: 混合整数最优控制的强化学习与模型预测控制桥梁及其在F1赛车策略中的应用
translation: 我们提出了一种混合强化学习（RL）和模型预测控制（MPC）框架，用于混合整数最优控制，其中离散变量进入成本和动力学，但不进入约束。现有的分层方法仅在离散动作空间使用RL，将连续优化留给MPC。与这些方法不同，我们在完整的混合动作空间上训练RL代理，确保与底层马尔可夫决策过程的成本一致性。在部署期间，RL actor在预测范围内展开，通过离散动作序列参数化无整数的非线性MPC，并提供连续的热启动。学习到的critic充当终端成本，以捕捉长期性能。我们证明了递归可行性，并在Formula 1赛车策略问题上验证了该框架。与离线混合整数非线性规划基准相比，混合方法实现了接近最优的性能，优于单独的RL代理。此外，混合方案通过在零重新训练成本下进行模块化MPC扩展，能够适应未知的干扰。
tldr: 提出一种结合强化学习（RL）和模型预测控制（MPC）的混合方法，用于解决混合整数最优控制问题，并在F1赛车策略问题上进行了验证，该方法优于单独的RL方法，并且能够适应未知的干扰。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的混合RL-MPC框架在混合整数最优控制领域具有重要意义，尤其是在计算复杂且需要快速决策的F1赛车策略问题上。通过联合训练RL和MPC，该方法有效地解决了传统方法中的一致性问题，并在性能和适应性上均表现出色。未来可以进一步探索该框架在其他复杂动态系统中的应用潜力。
motivation: 现有的分层方法仅在离散动作空间使用RL，而将连续优化留给MPC，这与成本函数不一致。
method: 提出一种混合RL和MPC框架，其中RL代理在完整的混合动作空间上进行训练，以确保与底层马尔可夫决策过程的成本一致性。在部署时，RL actor在预测范围内展开，通过离散动作序列参数化无整数的非线性MPC，并提供连续的初始热启动。学习到的critic作为终端成本，用于捕捉长期性能。
results: 该混合方法在与离线混合整数非线性规划基准相比时，达到了接近最优的性能，并且优于单独的RL代理。此外，通过模块化的MPC扩展，该混合方案能够在零重新训练成本的情况下适应未知的干扰。
conclusion: 该混合RL-MPC框架能够有效解决混合整数最优控制问题，并在F1赛车策略问题上展现出优越的性能和适应性。

title: Near-Optimal Four-Cycle Counting in Graph Streams
authors: Sebastian Lüderssen, Stefan Neumann, Pan Peng
abstract: We study four-cycle counting in arbitrary order graph streams. We present a 3-pass algorithm for $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximating the number of four-cycles using $\widetilde{O}(m/\sqrt{T})$ space, where $m$ is the number of edges and $T$ the number of four-cycles in the graph. This improves upon a 3-pass algorithm by Vorotnikova using space $\widetilde{O}(m/T^{1/3})$ and matches a multi-pass lower bound of $Ω(m/\sqrt{T})$ by McGregor and Vorotnikova.
zh_title: 图流中的近最优四环计数
translation: 我们研究了任意顺序图流中的四环计数问题。我们提出了一种3遍扫描算法，该算法使用$\widetilde{O}(m/\sqrt{T})$的空间对四环数量进行$(1+\varepsilon)$近似，其中$m$是边数，$T$是图中四环的数量。这一结果改进了Vorotnikova提出的使用$\widetilde{O}(m/T^{1/3})$空间的3遍扫描算法，并匹配了McGregor和Vorotnikova提出的$\Omega(m/\sqrt{T})$的多遍扫描下界。
tldr: 提出了一种图流中四环计数的3遍扫描算法，其空间复杂度达到$\widetilde{O}(m/\sqrt{T})$，达到了理论最优下界。
ai_comments: 该论文在图流算法领域取得了重要进展，通过改进空间复杂度，成功匹配了多遍扫描算法的理论下界，具有很高的理论价值。限制在于该算法仍需3遍扫描，且仅针对四环计数，未来可探索更少扫描次数或更一般子图的计数方法。
motivation: 在图流模型中，针对四环计数问题，现有的算法空间复杂度仍有优化空间，需要寻找更高效的算法以接近或达到理论下界。
method: 设计了一种3遍扫描的算法，利用图流特性对四环进行$(1+\varepsilon)$近似计数，空间复杂度优化至$\widetilde{O}(m/\sqrt{T})$。
results: 成功将四环计数算法的空间复杂度降低至$\widetilde{O}(m/\sqrt{T})$，不仅改进了Vorotnikova的已有结果，还匹配了McGregor和Vorotnikova提出的多遍扫描下界。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种针对四环计数问题的近最优算法，其空间复杂度达到了理论下界，显著提升了处理大规模图流数据的效率。

title: Video Patch Pruning: Efficient Video Instance Segmentation via Early Token Reduction
authors: Patrick Glandorf, Thomas Norrenbrock, Bodo Rosenhahn
abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated state-ofthe-art performance in several benchmarks, yet their high computational costs hinders their practical deployment. Patch Pruning offers significant savings, but existing approaches restrict token reduction to deeper layers, leaving early-stage compression unexplored. This limits their potential for holistic efficiency. In this work, we present a novel Video Patch Pruning framework (VPP) that integrates temporal prior knowledge to enable efficient sparsity within early ViT layers. Our approach is motivated by the observation that prior features extracted from deeper layers exhibit strong foreground selectivity. Therefore we propose a fully differentiable module for temporal mapping to accurately select the most relevant patches in early network stages. Notably, the proposed method enables a patch reduction of up to 60% in dense prediction tasks, exceeding the capabilities of conventional image-based patch pruning, which typically operate around a 30% patch sparsity. VPP excels the high-sparsity regime, sustaining remarkable performance even when patch usage is reduced below 55%. Specifically, it preserves stable results with a maximal performance drop of 0.6% on the Youtube-VIS 2021 dataset.
zh_title: 视频Patch剪枝：通过早期Token缩减实现高效视频实例分割
translation: 视觉Transformer（ViTs）在多个基准测试中展现了最先进的性能，但其高昂的计算成本阻碍了其实际部署。Patch剪枝提供了显著的节省，但现有方法将Token缩减限制在较深层，未探索早期压缩。这限制了它们在整体效率上的潜力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的视频Patch剪枝框架（VPP），该框架整合了时序先验知识，以在ViT早期层实现高效的稀疏性。我们的方法受到以下观察的启发：从深层提取的先验特征表现出强大的前景选择性。因此，我们提出了一个用于时间映射的完全可微模块，以准确选择早期网络阶段中最相关的Patch。值得注意的是，所提出的方法在密集预测任务中实现了高达60%的Patch缩减，超过了通常在30% Patch稀疏度下运行的传统基于图像的Patch剪枝的能力。VPP在高稀疏度环境下表现优异，即使在Patch使用率降低到55%以下时，仍能保持出色的性能。具体而言，它在Youtube-VIS 2021数据集上保持了稳定的结果，最大性能下降仅为0.6%。
tldr: VPP通过利用时序先验知识在ViT早期层进行高效Token剪枝，在视频实例分割中实现了高达60%的压缩率，同时保持了极高的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将时序先验知识引入到视频ViT的早期层进行Token剪枝，突破了传统剪枝多在深层进行的限制，显著提升了计算效率，在保持高精度的情况下实现了大幅度的冗余压缩，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的Patch剪枝方法大多局限于深层网络，未能充分利用早期层的压缩潜力，限制了ViT在视频任务中的整体计算效率。
method: 提出了一种名为视频Patch剪枝（VPP）的框架，利用深层特征提取的时序先验知识，通过一个完全可微的时间映射模块，在ViT的早期层对相关性较低的Patch进行修剪。
results: 在Youtube-VIS 2021数据集上实现了高达60%的Patch剪枝率，且在Patch使用率降至55%以下时，性能下降不超过0.6%，优于传统的图像级剪枝方法。
conclusion: VPP框架通过利用时序先验信息，实现了视频ViT在早期层的高效Token剪枝，在大幅降低计算量的同时保持了极高的模型性能。

title: LinguDistill: Recovering Linguistic Ability in Vision- Language Models via Selective Cross-Modal Distillation
authors: Patrick Amadeus Irawan, Erland Hilman Fuadi, Shanu Kumar, Alham Fikri Aji, Yova Kementchedjhieva
abstract: Adapting pretrained language models (LMs) into vision-language models (VLMs) can degrade their native linguistic capability due to representation shift and cross-modal interference introduced during multimodal adaptation. Such loss is difficult to recover, even with targeted task-specific fine-tuning using standard objectives. Prior recovery approaches typically introduce additional modules that act as intermediate alignment layers to maintain or isolate modality-specific subspaces, which increases architectural complexity, adds parameters at inference time, and limits flexibility across models and settings. We propose LinguDistill, an adapter-free distillation method that restores linguistic capability by utilizing the original frozen LM as a teacher. We overcome the key challenge of enabling vision-conditioned teacher supervision by introducing layer-wise KV-cache sharing, which exposes the teacher to the student's multimodal representations without modifying the architecture of either model. We then selectively distill the teacher's strong linguistic signal on language-intensive data to recover language capability, while preserving the student's visual grounding on multimodal tasks. As a result, LinguDistill recovers $\sim$10% of the performance lost on language and knowledge benchmarks, while maintaining comparable performance on vision-heavy tasks. Our findings demonstrate that linguistic capability can be recovered without additional modules, providing an efficient and practical solution to modality-specific degradation in multimodal models.
zh_title: 语言 the ability to understand and use language in vision-language models via selective cross-modal distillation
translation: 将预训练的语言模型（LMs）适配到视觉-语言模型（VLMs）中，可能会由于多模态适应过程中引入的表示偏移和跨模态干扰而损害其固有的语言能力。这种损失很难恢复，即使使用标准的客观目标进行有针对性的任务特定微调也是如此。先前的恢复方法通常会引入额外的模块，充当中间对齐层，以维护或隔离特定于模态的子空间，这会增加架构的复杂性，在推理时增加参数，并限制模型和设置的灵活性。我们提出 LinguDistill，一种无需适配器的蒸馏方法，它通过利用原始的冻结 LM 作为教师来恢复语言能力。我们通过引入层级 KV 缓存共享来克服实现视觉条件下的教师监督的关键挑战，该共享使教师模型能够接触到学生的跨模态表示，而无需修改任一模型的架构。然后，我们在语言密集型数据上选择性地蒸馏教师模型的强大语言信号，以恢复语言能力，同时保持学生模型在多模态任务上的视觉基础能力。结果，LinguDistill 在语言和知识基准测试上恢复了约 10% 的性能损失，同时在视觉密集型任务上保持了可比的性能。我们的发现表明，无需额外的模块即可恢复语言能力，为多模态模型中的特定于模态的退化问题提供了一种高效且实用的解决方案。
tldr: LinguDistill是一种无需额外模块的适配器式蒸馏方法，通过选择性地在语言密集型数据上蒸馏预训练语言模型（LM）的语言信号，来恢复视觉-语言模型（VLM）中因多模态适应而退化的语言能力，同时保持其视觉基础能力。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖且实用的方法 LinguDistill 来解决视觉-语言模型中的语言能力退化问题。通过避免增加额外的模型模块，该方法在效率和灵活性方面具有显著优势。层级 KV 缓存共享机制的引入是实现视觉条件化教师监督的关键创新点。然而，该方法在多模态任务上的性能保持能力和语言能力恢复的上限仍有待进一步探索。
motivation: 将预训练的语言模型（LMs）适应到视觉-语言模型（VLMs）中，会导致其原有的语言能力下降，并且难以通过标准的任务特定微调来恢复。现有的恢复方法通常会引入额外的模块，增加了复杂性、推理时间和模型/设置的灵活性限制。
method: 提出了一种名为 LinguDistill 的适配器无关的蒸馏方法。该方法利用原始的冻结 LM 作为教师模型，通过层级 KV 缓存共享实现视觉条件下的教师监督，从而在不修改模型架构的情况下，将教师模型的语言信号选择性地蒸馏到学生模型上，尤其是在语言密集型数据上，以恢复语言能力，同时保持学生模型在多模态任务上的视觉基础能力。
results: LinguDistill 在语言和知识基准测试上恢复了约 10% 的性能损失，同时在视觉密集型任务上保持了可比的性能。
conclusion: 研究表明，无需额外的模块即可恢复语言能力，为多模态模型中特定于模态的退化问题提供了一种高效且实用的解决方案。

title: Learning to Learn-at-Test-Time: Language Agents with Learnable Adaptation Policies
authors: Zhanzhi Lou, Hui Chen, Yibo Li, Qian Wang, Bryan Hooi
abstract: Test-Time Learning (TTL) enables language agents to iteratively refine their performance through repeated interactions with the environment at inference time. At the core of TTL is an adaptation policy that updates the actor policy based on experience from previous episodes, thereby improving future behavior. Existing methods rely on fixed, hand-crafted adaptation policies rather than optimizing them for downstream improvement. We argue that optimal adaptation policies should be learned from task environments, not hand-engineered based on human intuition. To achieve this, we introduce Meta-TTL, a framework that formulates the discovery of effective adaptation policies as a bi-level optimization problem. Within this framework, the inner loop executes the standard TTL process, measuring how effectively a candidate adaptation policy helps an agent correct errors across sequential episodes. Guided by the agent's performance, the outer loop employs evolutionary search over a diverse distribution of training tasks to iteratively refine the adaptation policy. We evaluate Meta-TTL on Jericho and WebArena-Lite across both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, using multiple meta-agent backbones. Results on both benchmarks show that Meta-TTL consistently outperforms hand-crafted baselines, suggesting that the optimized adaptation policy encodes transferable strategies that generalize beyond the training task distribution.
zh_title: 学会测试时学习：具有可学习适应策略的语言智能体
translation: 测试时学习（TTL）使语言智能体能够在推理阶段通过与环境的反复交互迭代优化其性能。TTL 的核心在于适应策略，它根据先前的情节经验更新执行策略，从而改善未来的行为。现有方法依赖于固定的、手工设计的适应策略，而不是针对下游改进进行优化。我们认为，最优的适应策略应该从任务环境中学习，而不是基于人类直觉进行手工设计。为此，我们引入了 Meta-TTL，这是一个将有效适应策略的发现公式化为双层优化问题的框架。在该框架内，内循环执行标准的 TTL 过程，衡量候选适应策略在帮助智能体纠正跨序列情节错误方面的有效性。在外循环中，基于智能体的表现，采用进化搜索对多样的训练任务分布进行搜索，从而迭代优化适应策略。我们在 Jericho 和 WebArena-Lite 上对多种元智能体骨干进行了同分布（ID）和分布外（OOD）设置下的评估。在两个基准测试上的结果表明，Meta-TTL 一致地优于手工设计的基线，这表明优化后的适应策略编码了可迁移的策略，能够泛化到训练任务分布之外。
tldr: Meta-TTL 通过进化搜索自动学习适应策略，使语言智能体在测试时能根据历史经验更好地自我改进，性能优于人工设计的基线。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种从数据中自动学习适应策略的方法，解决了依赖人工设计策略的局限性。其创新点在于将进化搜索与双层优化结合，使得代理具备了在测试时自我演化的能力，在泛化性方面表现出色。
motivation: 现有的测试时学习（TTL）方法高度依赖人工设计的固定适应策略，缺乏针对下游任务的优化，无法充分发挥智能体的自适应潜力。
method: 提出 Meta-TTL 框架，采用双层优化方案：内循环执行测试时学习（TTL）以评估适应策略效果，外循环通过进化搜索在多种训练任务上迭代优化适应策略。
results: 在 Jericho 和 WebArena-Lite 基准测试中，Meta-TTL 在同分布（ID）和分布外（OOD）场景下均显著优于手工设计的基线方法。
conclusion: Meta-TTL 通过元学习成功实现了适应策略的自动化发现，证明了学习到的适应策略优于人工设计的启发式规则，并具有良好的跨任务迁移能力。

title: Agentic Tool Use in Large Language Models
authors: Jinchao Hu, Meizhi Zhong, Kehai Chen, Xuefeng Bai, Min Zhang
abstract: Large language models are increasingly being deployed as autonomous agents yet their real world effectiveness depends on reliable tools for information retrieval, computation and external action. Existing studies remain fragmented across tasks, tool types, and training settings, lacking a unified view of how tool-use methods differ and evolve. This paper organizes the literature into three paradigms: prompting as plug-and-play, supervised tool learning and reward-driven tool policy learning, analyzes their methods, strengths and failure modes, reviews the evaluation landscape and highlights key challenges, aiming to address this fragmentation and provide a more structured evolutionary view of agentic tool use.
zh_title: 大语言模型中的智能体工具使用
translation: 大语言模型正日益被部署为自主智能体，但其在现实世界中的有效性取决于用于信息检索、计算和外部操作的可靠工具。现有的研究在任务、工具类型和训练设置方面仍然处于碎片化状态，缺乏关于工具使用方法如何差异化和演进的统一视角。本文将文献组织为三种范式：即插即用式提示、监督式工具学习和奖励驱动的工具策略学习，分析了它们的方法、优势和失败模式，回顾了评估格局并强调了关键挑战，旨在解决这种碎片化问题，并提供关于智能体工具使用更具结构性的演进视角。
tldr: 本文系统梳理了大语言模型中智能体使用工具的三种主要范式，并分析了其优劣、评估现状及未来挑战。
ai_comments: 该论文通过系统性梳理Agent工具使用的三种范式，为理解大语言模型在工具交互方面的演进提供了清晰的框架。其重要性在于将碎片化的研究领域结构化，有助于研究者更明确地评估不同方法（提示工程、监督学习、强化学习）的优劣。 limitations: 该论文属于综述性质，未提出全新的技术模型。
motivation: 现有的关于大语言模型工具使用的研究在任务、工具类型和训练环境方面极其分散，缺乏对不同方法差异和演进过程的统一认知。
method: 通过文献综述和分类分析，将工具使用方法归纳为三大范式：即插即用式提示（prompting as plug-and-play）、监督式工具学习（supervised tool learning）以及奖励驱动的工具策略学习（reward-driven tool policy learning）。
results: 系统性地分析了三种范式的优势与失败模式，梳理了当前的评估体系，并指出了该领域面临的关键挑战。
conclusion: 文章总结了Agent工具使用领域的现状，明确了从即插即用提示到奖励驱动策略学习的演进趋势，并指出了当前研究面临的关键挑战，为未来研究提供了指导方向。

title: Steering through Time: Blending Longitudinal Data with Simulation to Rethink Human-Autonomous Vehicle Interaction
authors: Yasaman Hakiminejad, Shiva Azimi, Luis Gomero, Elizabeth Pantesco, Irene P. Kan, Meltem Izzetoglu, Arash Tavakoli
abstract: As semi-automated vehicles (SAVs) become more common, ensuring effective human-vehicle interaction during control handovers remains a critical safety challenge. Existing studies often rely on single-session simulator experiments or naturalistic driving datasets, which often lack temporal context on drivers' cognitive and physiological states before takeover events. This study introduces a hybrid framework combining longitudinal mobile sensing with high-fidelity driving simulation to examine driver readiness in semi-automated contexts. In a pilot study with 38 participants, we collected 7 days of wearable physiological data and daily surveys on stress, arousal, valence, and sleep quality, followed by an in-lab simulation with scripted takeover events under varying secondary task conditions. Multimodal sensing, including eye tracking, fNIRS, and physiological measures, captured real-time responses. Preliminary analysis shows the framework's feasibility and individual variability in baseline and in-task measures; for example, fixation duration and takeover control time differed by task type, and RMSSD showed high inter-individual stability. This proof-of-concept supports the development of personalized, context-aware driver monitoring by linking temporally layered data with real-time performance.
zh_title: 驾驭时间：融合纵向数据与模拟仿真，重新思考人机自动驾驶交互
translation: 随着半自动驾驶汽车（SAVs）的普及，确保控制权移交过程中的有效人机交互仍是一项关键的安全挑战。现有的研究往往依赖于单次模拟实验或自然驾驶数据集，这些研究通常缺乏对驾驶员在接管事件前认知和生理状态的时间背景了解。本研究引入了一个混合框架，结合纵向移动感知与高保真驾驶模拟，以检查半自动驾驶环境下的驾驶员准备状态。在一项包含38名参与者的试点研究中，我们收集了7天的可穿戴生理数据，以及关于压力、觉醒度、效价和睡眠质量的每日调查，随后进行了包含不同次要任务条件下脚本化接管事件的室内模拟。多模态传感技术（包括眼动追踪、fNIRS和生理测量）捕捉了实时反应。初步分析显示了该框架的可行性以及基线和任务测量中的个体差异；例如，注视持续时间和接管控制时间因任务类型而异，且RMSSD显示出高个体间稳定性。这一概念验证支持通过链接时间分层数据与实时性能，开发个性化的、上下文感知的驾驶员监控系统。
tldr: 研究通过结合7天的长期生理监测与驾驶模拟实验，揭示了驾驶员的长期状态对自动驾驶接管表现的影响，为个性化驾驶监控提供了新思路。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将长期的环境背景数据（纵向数据）与短期的模拟驾驶行为数据相结合，为理解驾驶员在自动驾驶接管过程中的个体差异提供了更深入的维度。这种方法有助于从静态评估转向个性化的、上下文感知的驾驶员监控系统。局限性在于样本量较小（38人），属于初步验证阶段。
motivation: 现有研究通常依赖单次模拟实验或自然驾驶数据，缺乏对驾驶员接管前长期认知和生理状态背景的考量，难以有效评估接管过程中的安全性。
method: 采用混合研究框架：通过7天的可穿戴设备收集生理数据和日常问卷，随后进行高保真模拟驾驶实验，并结合眼动追踪、fNIRS及生理指标进行多模态数据分析。
results: 初步分析验证了该框架的可行性，发现驾驶员在基线水平和任务表现上存在显著个体差异，且任务类型对注视时长和接管时间有显著影响，RMSSD表现出较高的个体稳定性。
conclusion: 本研究证实了融合纵向移动感知与高保真模拟实验框架的可行性，并强调了考虑驾驶员长期生理和心理状态对于理解接管表现的重要性。

title: Influence of the geometry on the mechanical performance of tubular interlockings: A study of the Sine Block
authors: Domen Macek, Meike Weiß, Reymond Akpanya, Tim Brepols, Hagen Holthusen, Alice C. Niemeyer
abstract: Topological interlocking assemblies (TIA) are arrangements of blocks such that rigid-body motions of the blocks are fully constrained by their neighbours and a fixed frame. In this work, we investigate tubular interlocking structures derived from the sine curve and parametrised by several geometric design parameters. We analyse the behaviour of these parametrised tubular interlockings under various boundary conditions and examine how our proposed parameters influence the mechanical response. For this purpose, we first develop a simplified multibody dynamics formulation that enables an efficient exploration of how the design parameters of the block influence the load transfer within the assembly. To further corroborate these results, we perform several finite element simulations, which give insights into the mechanical behaviour of our proposed TIA. Our results show that the block geometry plays a decisive role in the mechanical performance of the corresponding TIA. We additionally discuss the problem of exploding TIAs and demonstrate that the TIA resulting from our Sine Block does not exhibit this behaviour. Lastly, we provide evidence that non-exploding TIAs possess better mechanical properties than exploding ones.
zh_title: 几何形状对管状互锁力学性能的影响：以正弦块为例
translation: 拓扑互锁组件（TIA）是指通过邻近组件和固定框架完全约束刚体运动的块体排列。本文研究了源自正弦曲线并由多个几何设计参数参数化的管状互锁结构。我们分析了这些参数化管状互锁结构在各种边界条件下的行为，并考察了我们提出的参数如何影响其力学响应。为此，我们首先开发了一种简化的多体动力学公式，能够高效地探索块体设计参数如何影响组件内的负载传递。为了进一步验证这些结果，我们进行了多项有限元模拟，深入了解了我们提出的TIA的力学行为。结果表明，块体几何形状在相应TIA的力学性能中起着决定性作用。此外，我们讨论了TIA的“爆炸”问题，并证明了由我们的正弦块产生的TIA不会表现出这种行为。最后，我们提供了证据，证明不发生“爆炸”的TIA比会发生“爆炸”的TIA具有更好的力学性能。
tldr: 本文探讨了基于正弦曲线的管状拓扑互锁结构，通过多体动力学和有限元分析发现，合理的几何设计不仅能优化力学性能，还能有效解决结构“爆炸”问题。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入正弦曲线几何参数化管状拓扑互锁结构，并开发了多体动力学公式进行高效分析，这是一个创新的设计思路。其核心价值在于揭示了几何形状与互锁结构力学性能之间的定量关系，并成功解决了互锁结构常见的“爆炸”问题，为高性能材料的设计提供了重要的理论依据。
motivation: 拓扑互锁组件（TIA）的力学性能受几何形状影响显著，为了系统地理解不同设计参数对互锁结构力学响应及稳定性的影响，需要建立一套高效的分析框架。
method: 1. 提出基于正弦曲线的参数化管状互锁结构设计；2. 开发简化的多体动力学公式以探索设计参数对负载传递的影响；3. 结合有限元模拟进行验证与分析。
results: 研究表明，区块几何形状对TIA的力学性能起决定性作用；提出的正弦块设计成功规避了TIA的“爆炸”问题，且非爆炸型TIA展现出比爆炸型TIA更优异的力学属性。
conclusion: 几何参数对管状互锁结构的力学性能具有决定性影响。基于正弦曲线设计的互锁结构能够有效避免“爆炸”现象，并展现出优于常规结构的力学表现。

title: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants
authors: Deepak Nathani, Cheng Zhang, Chang Huan, Jiaming Shan, Yinfei Yang, Alkesh Patel, Zhe Gan, William Yang Wang, Michael Saxon, Xin Eric Wang
abstract: Proactive agents that anticipate user needs and autonomously execute tasks hold great promise as digital assistants, yet the lack of realistic user simulation frameworks hinders their development. Existing approaches model apps as flat tool-calling APIs, failing to capture the stateful and sequential nature of user interaction in digital environments and making realistic user simulation infeasible. We introduce Proactive Agent Research Environment (Pare), a framework for building and evaluating proactive agents in digital environments. Pare models applications as finite state machines with stateful navigation and state-dependent action space for the user simulator, enabling active user simulation. Building on this foundation, we present Pare-Bench, a benchmark of 143 diverse tasks spanning communication, productivity, scheduling, and lifestyle apps, designed to test context observation, goal inference, intervention timing, and multi-app orchestration.
zh_title: 主动代理研究环境：模拟活跃用户以评估主动助手
translation: 主动代理研究环境：模拟活跃用户以评估主动助手。主动代理能够预测用户需求并自主执行任务，作为数字助手具有巨大潜力，然而，现实的用户模拟框架的缺乏阻碍了它们的发展。现有的方法将应用程序建模为扁平的工具调用API，未能捕捉数字环境中用户交互的状态性和顺序性，使得现实的用户模拟不可行。我们引入了主动代理研究环境（Pare），一个在数字环境中构建和评估主动代理的框架。Pare将应用程序建模为具有状态导航和状态相关动作空间的有限状态机，用于用户模拟器，从而实现积极的用户模拟。在此基础上，我们提出了Pare-Bench，一个包含143个涵盖通信、生产力、日程安排和生活方式应用程序的diverse任务的基准，旨在测试上下文观察、目标推断、干预时机和多应用程序编排。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为Pare的新框架，用于在数字环境中构建和评估主动代理，通过将应用程序建模为有限状态机来克服现有用户模拟方法的局限性，并引入了包含143个多样化任务的Pare-Bench基准来测试代理的各项能力。
ai_comments: 该研究解决了主动代理评估中的一个关键挑战——缺乏现实的用户模拟。通过将应用程序建模为有限状态机，Pare框架有望提供更准确、更具状态感的用户行为模拟。Pare-Bench基准的构建为评估这些代理提供了一个标准化的平台，其任务的多样性也增加了评估的全面性。然而，该框架在实际应用中的可扩展性和效率，以及模拟用户行为的真实性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 现有用户模拟框架无法捕捉数字环境中用户交互的状态性和顺序性，阻碍了主动代理（能够预测用户需求并自主执行任务的数字助手）的开发。
method: 提出Pare框架，将应用程序建模为具有状态导航和状态相关动作空间的有限状态机，从而实现用户模拟器的积极用户模拟。在此基础上，构建了Pare-Bench基准，包含143个涵盖通信、生产力、日程安排和生活方式应用程序的diverse任务。
results: 构建了一个名为Pare的新框架，用于在数字环境中构建和评估主动代理，并推出了Pare-Bench基准，包含143个多样化任务，用于测试主动代理在上下文观察、目标推断、干预时机和多应用程序编排方面的能力。
conclusion: Pare框架和Pare-Bench基准为开发和评估能够真正理解和预测用户需求的主动代理提供了关键支持，克服了现有模拟方法的局限性。

title: Disentangling to Re-couple: Resolving the Similarity-Controllability Paradox in Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation
authors: Shuang Li, Chao Deng, Hang Chen, Liqun Liu, Zhenyu Hu, Te Cao, Mengge Xue, Yuan Chen, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang
abstract: Subject-Driven Text-to-Image (T2I) Generation aims to preserve a subject's identity while editing its context based on a text prompt. A core challenge in this task is the "similarity-controllability paradox", where enhancing textual control often degrades the subject's fidelity, and vice-versa. We argue this paradox stems from the ambiguous role of text prompts, which are often tasked with describing both the subject and the desired modifications, leading to conflicting signals for the model. To resolve this, we propose DisCo, a novel framework that first Disntangles and then re-Couples visual and textual information. First, our textual-visual decoupling module isolates the sources of information: subject identity is extracted exclusively from the reference image with the entity word of the subject, while the text prompt is simplified to contain only the modification command, where the subject refers to general pronouns, eliminating descriptive ambiguity. However, this strict separation can lead to unnatural compositions between the subject and its contexts. We address this by designing a dedicated reward signal and using reinforcement learning to seamlessly recouple the visually-defined subject and the textually-generated context. Our approach effectively resolves the paradox, enabling simultaneous high-fidelity subject preservation and precise textual control. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing highly realistic and coherent images.
zh_title: 解耦到重新耦合：解决主观驱动的文本到图像生成中的相似性-可控性悖论
translation: 主体驱动的文本到图像（T2I）生成旨在在根据文本提示编辑其上下文的同时，保留主体的身份。这项任务的一个核心挑战是“相似性-可控性悖论”，即增强文本控制通常会降低主体的保真度，反之亦然。我们认为这个悖论源于文本提示的模糊作用，它们通常被赋予描述主体和所需修改的任务，导致模型接收到冲突的信号。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了DisCo，一个新颖的框架，首先解耦然后重新耦合视觉和文本信息。首先，我们的文本-视觉解耦模块分离信息来源：主体身份信息仅从参考图像和主体的实体词中提取，而文本提示则被简化为仅包含修改命令，其中主体指代通用代词，从而消除了描述性模糊。然而，这种严格的分离可能导致主体与其上下文之间产生不自然的组合。我们通过设计专门的奖励信号并使用强化学习来解决这个问题，以无缝地重新耦合视觉定义的主体和文本生成的上下文。我们的方法有效地解决了这个悖论，能够同时实现高保真度的主体保存和精确的文本控制。大量的实验表明，我们的方法取得了最先进的性能，能够生成高度逼真且连贯的图像。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为DisCo的新框架，通过解耦和重新耦合视觉与文本信息来解决文本到图像生成中的相似性-可控性悖论，实现了高保真度和精确控制。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决文本到图像生成中的一个关键挑战——相似性-可控性悖论。通过解耦和重新耦合视觉与文本信息，DisCo框架有望在保持主体身份的同时实现更精确的文本控制。该方法在实验中取得了优异的成果，显示了其潜力和实用性。
motivation: 文本到图像生成任务面临相似性-可控性悖论：增强文本控制会降低主体保真度，反之亦然。这是因为文本提示常被用于描述主体和修改内容，导致模型接收到冲突信号。
method: DisCo框架首先通过文本-视觉解耦模块分离信息来源：主体身份信息仅从参考图像和实体词中提取，文本提示简化为仅包含修改指令，并使用通用代词指代主体。然后，通过设计专门的奖励信号并使用强化学习，将视觉定义的主体与文本生成的上下文无缝地重新耦合。
results: 该方法有效解决了悖论，能够同时实现高保真度的主体保存和精确的文本控制。实验证明，该方法达到了最先进的性能，能够生成高度逼真且连贯的图像。
conclusion: DisCo框架通过解耦和重新耦合信息，成功解决了文本到图像生成中的相似性-可控性悖论，实现了主体保真度和文本控制的双重优化。

title: MotionGrounder: Grounded Multi-Object Motion Transfer via Diffusion Transformer
authors: Samuel Teodoro, Yun Chen, Agus Gunawan, Soo Ye Kim, Jihyong Oh, Munchurl Kim
abstract: Motion transfer enables controllable video generation by transferring temporal dynamics from a reference video to synthesize a new video conditioned on a target caption. However, existing Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based methods are limited to single-object videos, restricting fine-grained control in real-world scenes with multiple objects. In this work, we introduce MotionGrounder, a DiT-based framework that firstly handles motion transfer with multi-object controllability. Our Flow-based Motion Signal (FMS) in MotionGrounder provides a stable motion prior for target video generation, while our Object-Caption Alignment Loss (OCAL) grounds object captions to their corresponding spatial regions. We further propose a new Object Grounding Score (OGS), which jointly evaluates (i) spatial alignment between source video objects and their generated counterparts and (ii) semantic consistency between each generated object and its target caption. Our experiments show that MotionGrounder consistently outperforms recent baselines across quantitative, qualitative, and human evaluations.
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/motiongrounder-site/
zh_title: 基于扩散 Transformer 的运动基础：面向多目标的运动迁移
translation: 运动迁移通过将参考视频的时间动态迁移到以目标标题为条件的合成新视频，实现了可控的视频生成。然而，现有的基于扩散 Transformer (DiT) 的方法仅限于单目标视频，限制了在具有多个目标的真实场景中的精细控制。在这项工作中，我们引入了 MotionGrounder，一个基于 DiT 的框架，首次实现了具有多目标可控性的运动迁移。我们提出的 MotionGrounder 中的基于流的运动信号 (FMS) 为目标视频生成提供了稳定的运动先验，而我们的目标-标题对齐损失 (OCAL) 将目标标题与其对应的空间区域进行对齐。我们进一步提出了新的目标基础分数 (OGS)，它联合评估 (i) 源视频对象与其生成对应物之间的空间对齐以及 (ii) 每个生成对象与其目标标题之间的语义一致性。我们的实验表明，MotionGrounder 在定量、定性和人类评估方面始终优于现有基线。
tldr: MotionGrounder 是一个基于扩散 Transformer 的新框架，首次实现了多目标运动迁移，通过引入基于流的运动信号和目标-标题对齐损失，实现了对目标视频的精细控制，并在各项评估中超越了现有方法。
ai_comments: 该研究解决了现有运动迁移技术在处理多目标场景时的局限性，通过引入新颖的 FMS 和 OCAL 机制，并提出 OGS 进行综合评估，为实现更精细、更可控的视频生成开辟了道路。其在多项评估中的优异表现，预示着该方法在视频编辑和内容创作领域的巨大潜力。
motivation: 现有基于扩散 Transformer (DiT) 的运动迁移方法仅限于单目标视频，无法在包含多个目标的真实场景中实现精细控制。
method: 引入了基于流的运动信号 (FMS) 作为运动先验，并提出了目标-标题对齐损失 (OCAL) 来将目标标题与其对应的空间区域对齐。此外，还提出了一种新的目标基础分数 (OGS) 来评估源视频对象与其生成对应物之间的空间对齐以及每个生成对象与其目标标题之间的语义一致性。
results: 实验表明，MotionGrounder 在定量、定性和人类评估方面始终优于现有基线方法。
conclusion: MotionGrounder 成功实现了多目标运动迁移，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在各项评估中取得了优异的性能。

title: PanoAir: A Panoramic Visual-Inertial SLAM with Cross-Time Real-World UAV Dataset
authors: Yiyang Wu, Xiaohu Zhang, Yanjin Du, Tongsu Zhang, Chujun Li, Siyang Chen, Guoyi Zhang, Xiangpeng Xu
abstract:
Accurate pose estimation is fundamental for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) applications, where Visual-Inertial SLAM (VI-SLAM) provides a cost-effective solution for localization and mapping. However, existing VI-SLAM methods mainly rely on sensors with limited fields of view (FoV), which can lead to drift and even failure in complex UAV scenarios. Although panoramic cameras provide omnidirectional perception to improve robustness, panoramic VI-SLAM and corresponding real-world datasets for UAVs remain underexplored. To address this limitation, we first construct a real-world panoramic visual-inertial dataset covering diverse flight conditions, including varying illumination, altitudes, trajectory lengths, and motion dynamics. To achieve accurate and robust pose estimation under such challenging UAV scenarios, we propose a panoramic VI-SLAM framework that exploits the omnidirectional FoV via the proposed panoramic feature extraction and panoramic loop closure, enhancing feature constraints and ensuring global consistency. Extensive experiments on both the proposed dataset and public benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy, robustness, and consistency compared to existing approaches. Moreover, deployment on embedded platform validates its practical applicability, achieving comparable computational efficiency to PC implementations.
  The source code and dataset are publicly available at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lG1Upn6yi-N6tYpEHAt6dfR1uhzNtWbT/view
zh_title: PanoAir：一种带有跨时间真实世界无人机数据集的全景视觉惯性 SLAM 系统
translation: 精确的姿态估计是无人机（UAV）应用的基础，视觉惯性 SLAM（VI-SLAM）为定位和建图提供了一种经济高效的解决方案。然而，现有的 VI-SLAM 方法主要依赖视场角（FoV）受限的传感器，这在复杂的无人机场景中可能导致漂移甚至失效。尽管全景相机通过全方位感知提高了鲁棒性，但针对无人机的全景 VI-SLAM 和相应的真实世界数据集仍未得到充分探索。为了解决这一局限性，我们首先构建了一个真实世界的全景视觉惯性数据集，涵盖了多样的飞行条件，包括不同的光照、高度、轨迹长度和运动动态。为了在如此具有挑战性的无人机场景下实现精确且鲁棒的姿态估计，我们提出了一个全景 VI-SLAM 框架，通过所提出的全景特征提取和全景回环检测来利用全方位视场，从而增强特征约束并确保全局一致性。在所提数据集和公共基准上的广泛实验表明，与现有方法相比，我们的方法实现了更高的精度、鲁棒性和一致性。此外，在嵌入式平台上的部署验证了其实际适用性，实现了与 PC 实现相当的计算效率。源码和数据集已公开。
tldr: PanoAir 通过利用全景视觉和惯性传感器，解决了无人机在复杂环境下定位漂移的问题，并提供了一个全新的全景数据集。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将全景视觉与惯性导航相结合，解决了传统受限视场角传感器在无人机复杂环境下鲁棒性不足的问题。通过构建高质量的真实世界全景数据集，填补了该领域的空白。其局限性可能在于对全景图像畸变校正的计算消耗，尽管文中提到在嵌入式平台有良好表现。
motivation: 现有 VI-SLAM 方法多依赖视场角受限的传感器，在复杂无人机场景下易产生漂移或失效，且缺乏专门的无人机全景视觉惯性数据集。
method: 提出了一种全景 VI-SLAM 框架，利用全景特征提取和全景回环检测技术，充分利用全方位视场（FoV）来增强特征约束并保证全局一致性。
results: 在自建数据集和公开基准测试中，PanoAir 表现出比现有方法更高的精度、鲁棒性和一致性，并在嵌入式平台上验证了其实用性。
conclusion: PanoAir 为无人机在复杂环境下的高精度、鲁棒性定位提供了一种有效的全景 VI-SLAM 解决方案，并通过公开数据集推动了该领域的研究。

title: Perturb-and-Restore: Simulation-driven Structural Augmentation Framework for Imbalance Chromosomal Anomaly Detection
authors: Yilan Zhang, Hanbiao Chen, Changchun Yang, Yuetan Chu, Siyuan Chen, Jing Wu, Jingdong Hu, Na Li, Junkai Su, Yuxuan Chen, Ao Xu, Xin Gao, Aihua Yin
abstract: Detecting structural chromosomal abnormalities is crucial for accurate diagnosis and management of genetic disorders. However, collecting sufficient structural abnormality data is extremely challenging and costly in clinical practice, and not all abnormal types can be readily collected. As a result, deep learning approaches face significant performance degradation due to the severe imbalance and scarcity of abnormal chromosome data. To address this challenge, we propose a Perturb-and-Restore (P&R), a simulation-driven structural augmentation framework that effectively alleviates data imbalance in chromosome anomaly detection. The P&R framework comprises two key components: (1) Structure Perturbation and Restoration Simulation, which generates synthetic abnormal chromosomes by perturbing chromosomal banding patterns of normal chromosomes followed by a restoration diffusion network that reconstructs continuous chromosome content and edges, thus eliminating reliance on rare abnormal samples; and (2) Energy-guided Adaptive Sampling, an energy score-based online selection strategy that dynamically prioritizes high-quality synthetic samples by referencing the energy distribution of real samples. To evaluate our method, we construct a comprehensive structural anomaly dataset consisting of over 260,000 chromosome images, including 4,242 abnormal samples spanning 24 categories. Experimental results demonstrate that the P&R framework achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, surpassing existing methods with an average improvement of 8.92% in sensitivity, 8.89% in precision, and 13.79% in F1-score across all categories.
comment: This preprint version of the manuscript has been submitted to the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI) for review

title: Sparkle: A Robust and Versatile Representation for Point Cloud based Human Motion Capture
authors: Yiming Ren, Yujing Sun, Aoru Xue, Kwok-Yan Lam, Yuexin Ma
abstract: Point cloud-based motion capture leverages rich spatial geometry and privacy-preserving sensing, but learning robust representations from noisy, unstructured point clouds remains challenging. Existing approaches face a struggle trade-off between point-based methods (geometrically detailed but noisy) and skeleton-based ones (robust but oversimplified). We address the fundamental challenge: how to construct an effective representation for human motion capture that can balance expressiveness and robustness. In this paper, we propose Sparkle, a structured representation unifying skeletal joints and surface anchors with explicit kinematic-geometric factorization.
